$170/month (with performance-based increases as the store generates sales)

This role is execution-focused, with an understanding that content is used to drive traffic and sales to the Shopify store. You will be given videos, captions, pictures, and a posting schedule. • Reliable internet connection

• Consistent daily availability



Workload

• Daily posting required (including weekends)

Performance & Growth

• Salary starts at $170/month

• Compensation will increase as the store generates sales

• Opportunity for long-term role with expanded responsibilities



Important Traits

• Consistency > creativity

• Discipline > ideas

• Accuracy > speed

How to Apply



Please include:

1. Your experience using Meta Business Suite (required)

2. Your experience with
/TikTok posting

, TikTok, or Shopify accounts you’ve managed (if available)

6. Confirmation you can post daily without missing days

7. Your timezone



We are looking for someone dependable who understands the importance of consistent posting + engagement to support Shopify sales growth, and who can follow a structured system while contributing to long-term success.

title: Project Administrator
description:
We are seeking a Project Administrator to support multiple active construction projects. This role is critical to ensuring project operations remain organized, compliant, and moving forward efficiently while supporting project managers and field teams through construction documentation cycles and jobsite coordination.



The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with construction documentation workflows, strong knowledge of project management software like Procore, and the ability to manage competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment. This position collaborates cross-functionally with project managers, superintendents, subcontractors, and consultants to maintain project accuracy and efficiency throughout the construction lifecycle.



Job Responsibilities:



-Support project setup and maintain accurate project documentation in construction management software.

-Manage and track RFIs, submittals, and change orders across multiple active projects.

-Prepare and administer subcontract agreements and assist with contract execution workflows.

-Coordinate subcontractor onboarding, including insurance certificates and compliance tracking.

-Track subcontractor insurance, lien releases, and closeout documentation.

-Assist with pay application support and related documentation coordination.

-Maintain drawing logs and ensure current plan sets are distributed to project teams.

-Support communication between field teams and office staff across projects.

-Collect, organize, and assemble project closeout documentation packages.

-Help ensure project information is accurate, current, and accessible across teams.

-Identify opportunities to improve consistency and efficiency in project operations.



Qualifications:



-Bachelor's degree with at least 5 years of relevant experience in construction project support, or equivalent work experience.

-Hands-on experience with construction documentation workflows, including RFIs, submittals, change orders, and closeout packages.

-Experience supporting multiple active construction projects simultaneously.

-Strong working knowledge of Procore or similar construction management software.

-Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail in document-heavy environments.

-Ability to manage competing deadlines in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

-Self-motivated and able to work both independently and collaboratively.

-Strong written and verbal communication skills across project teams.

-U.S. client experience required.



Requirements:



-Updated Resume/CV.

-Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

-Reliable internet connection and personal computer.

-UPS/battery backup to ensure continuity during power interruptions.



Benefits:



-Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.

-WFH set-up.

-Opportunities for career advancement.

-HMO coverage for employee and immediate family members.



Join our team now and be part of the top 1% talent in the Philippines!

title: Marketing Operations Manager — Land Investing (Remote, Full-Time)
description:
We're a US-based rural land investing company. We buy underpriced vacant land and resell it, and we find our deals by mailing cash/range offers to landowners. Right now we mail 4,000 - 5,000 letters a month. We're scaling to 10,000–15,000 a month — and we need one person to own that entire engine so it grows without breaking.



That person is who this is for.



What you'd actually own:

You'd run the full marketing and direct-mail system and manage the two people in it — one who prices parcels, one who builds and cleans our mailing lists. Every batch of letters that goes out gets your approval first. Every pricing sheet gets your review before it's trusted.



This is a judgment job, not a task job. Most days, the hardest decisions have no clean right answer. Is this comparable sale a true comp or an outlier we should remove? Does this pricing sheet hold up, or is something off in the data? Do these letters go in the mail today, or do they get sent back for a fix? We have clear frameworks and rules for making these calls — but rules only get you 80% of the way. The last 20% is your thinking. We need someone whose default is to reason it through, not guess



You'd be replacing the owner on this system so he can focus elsewhere. That means real autonomy — and real accountability for the numbers.



This is for you if:

- You've worked in US land or real estate investing and understand comps, pricing, and direct mail (or you can prove you'll learn our system fast and think clearly inside it).

- You genuinely like making judgment calls under uncertainty and can explain why you d
 what you d
.

- You've managed people before and can hold a small team to a standard without being told how.

- You see a system, spot what's about to break as volume doubles, and fix it before it does.

- You're comfortable owning decisions that involve real money going out the door.



This is NOT for you if:

- You wait to be told what to do next.

- Numbers and pricing logic stress you out or bore you.

- You've never managed anyone and don't want to start.

- You'd rather execute a clear task than make an ambiguous call.



Compensation: $2,000/month (paid on the 1st and 15th) for an experienced operator, with a performance bonus tied to growing the engine while keeping quality high. Full-time, long-term, with annual raises and 13th-month pay. We invest in people who own their work.



The logistics:

- Full-time, ~40 hours/week.

- Paid twice a month via Wise, in USD, on the 1st and 15th.

- Long-term role — we're an established operation [operating since 2022 / 4 years in business] and we're hiring someone to stay and grow with us, not to fill a gap.

- You'll need a reliable computer and a backup internet option.



To apply, send:

- Your resume

- A short video, three minutes max, covering two things:

                  1. In one or two sentences tell us what you think this job actually is. (We want to know you read this and understood this)

                  2. Tell us about a work decision you made where the right answer wasn't obvious, what you chose and why.



Start your message with the word STILLPOINT so we know you read this far. Applications without it won't be reviewed.

title: Senior Evaluator Success Coordinator
description:
Encina Associates is a California-based management company operating within the workers' compensation system. We recruit, credential, and support licensed psychologists and psychiatrists who perform independent medical-legal evaluations (QMEs) for the California DWC. We are growing rapidly and building the infrastructure to support a panel of 100+ evaluators over the next 18 months.



This is a senior administrative role at the center of our operations. You will own the evaluator relationship at the administrative level — from the 
nt a candidate enters our recruitment pipeline through their credentialing, onboarding, and ongoing panel membership. You will also serve as our primary point of accountability with our fulfillment vendor, ensuring scheduling and case coordination runs smoothly on behalf of our evaluators.



This is not a general VA role. We are looking for someone with strong professional experience, excellent written English, sound judgment, and the ability to manage complex administrative processes with minimal supervision. You will work directly with the founder and be a key member of a small, high-functioning team.



---



## Core Responsibilities



### 1. Recruitment Pipeline Support

- Track all prospective evaluator candidates in our system (Base44), ensuring no prospect goes stale

- Flag outreach follow-ups when a candidate hasn't heard from us within a defined window

- Draft follow-up
s for founder review and approval

- Maintain accurate pipeline status for all active prospects

- Build familiarity with incoming recruits early in the cycle to support a warm handoff into onboarding



### 2. Credentialing & QME Registration

- Guide newly approved evaluators through the DWC QME registration process

- Track submission status and follow up with evaluators and DWC as needed

- Maintain accurate records of each evaluator's registration status, panel number, and renewal timeline

- Proactively flag upcoming renewal deadlines (reappointment cycles are every two years)



### 3. Onboarding Coordination

- Coordinate onboarding communications for new evaluators following exam passage

- Ensure evaluators complete required training modules (via TalentLMS) on schedule

- Track document completion (contracts, W-9s, platform access, etc.)

- Serve as the primary point of contact for administrative onboarding questions



### 4. Evaluator Liaison (Ongoing)

- Field procedural questions from evaluators once they begin receiving evaluations (e.g., scheduling process, what to expect from our fulfillment vendor, report submission logistics)

- Respond to routine evaluator inquiries independently; escalate clinical or judgment-sensitive questions to the founder

- Maintain a warm, professional tone in all evaluator communications — evaluators are licensed professionals and our primary relationship



### 5. CE Compliance Tracking

- Monitor each evaluator's continuing education (CE) requirements and completion status

- Track CE hours relative to reappointment deadlines

- Send reminders and provide guidance on approved CE providers and courses



### 6. Fulfillment Oversight & eData Accountability

- Monitor scheduling and case coordination activity performed by our fulfillment vendor (eData)

- Flag delays, stale cases, or missed follow-ups using our Airtable case tracker

- Escalate vendor performance issues to the founder with documented examples

- Serve as the internal point of accountability for fulfillment quality — you do not execute fulfillment directly, but you ensure it is being executed correctly



---



## What We're Looking For



**Required:**

- 3–5+ years of administrative or operations experience in a professional services environment (healthcare, legal, or similar preferred)

- Excellent written English — you will be communicating directly with licensed physicians and psychologists

- Strong organizational skills and experience managing multiple parallel workflows

- Comfort with technology: you will use Airtable, Base44, TalentLMS, Google Workspace, and
 daily

- Ability to work independently and manage your own priorities without close supervision

- Reliable availability during California business hours (overlap required)



**Strongly preferred:**

- Experience supporting US-based healthcare or mental health practices

- Familiarity with credentialing, licensing, or compliance workflows

- Experience managing or interfacing with outsourced vendor teams

- Warm, professional communication style — you will represent Encina to our evaluator panel



---



## What to Expect



- **Start date:** September 1, 2026 (target)

- **Hours:** Approximately 35–40 hours/week

- **Compensation:** ~$2,000/month (contractor)

- **Reporting to:** Founder & CEO

- **Location:** Remote; Philippines-based candidates strongly preferred



---

2. A brief note (3–5 sentences) describing a time you managed a complex administrative process with multiple moving parts — what was the situation, what did you own, and what was the outcome?



Applications without the brief note will not be reviewed.

title: Quickbooks, ProConnect, Admin
description:
Job Overview



I’m the owner of ClearBooks CPA, a US-based CPA firm that handles bookkeeping, tax

preparation, and back-office support for small businesses, real-estate operators, and individual

filers. I’m hiring one experienced Admin / Bookkeeper / Tax Preparer to take real ownership of a

book of work — not a faceless data-entry seat. You’ll talk to clients in writing, call agencies on

our behalf, keep books current in QuickBooks Online, and help prepare returns in Intuit

ProConnect.



If you’ve worked in a US CPA or bookkeeping firm before, communicate clearly in English, and

want a long-term home rather than another short-term gig, please keep reading.

What You’ll Own



1. Bookkeeping (QuickBooks Online)

• Full-cycle monthly bookkeeping for assigned clients: categorization, bank and credit-card

reconciliations, GL clean-up, and month-end close

• Maintaining a clean chart of accounts and consistent class/location coding across clients

• Producing monthly financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) and flagging

anomalies before they reach the client

• Tracking fixed assets, prepaids, loan amortization schedules, and recurring journal

entries



2. Tax Preparation (Intuit ProConnect)

• Preparing federal and state individual and business returns (1040, 1065, 1120-S, 1120)

in ProConnect under my review

• Inputting K-1s, depreciation, and multi-state allocations accurately

• Building and maintaining tax workpapers in Excel/Google Sheets that tie cleanly to the

return

• Tracking each return’s status, missing items, and review notes through to e-file

acceptance



3. Calling Agencies & Notice Resolution

• Calling the IRS, state DORs, FTB, EDD, and other agencies on behalf of clients to

resolve notices, request transcripts, set up installment agreements, and confirm payment

posting

• Drafting POA (Form 2848) and TIA packages, and managing follow-up until each issue

is closed

• Maintaining a clear log of every call: who you spoke to, badge/ID, date/time, outcome,

and next step

• Comfortable navigating long hold times and IVR menus without losing focus



4. Google Drive & Document Management

• Owning our Google Drive client-folder structure: keeping every client’s documents

named, dated, and filed per our SOP

• Routing inbound documents from
 and client portals into the right folder the day

they arrive

• Maintaining year-folders, source-document binders, and tax-prep checklists so any team

member can find a document in under 60 seconds

• Spotting missing items proactively (W-2s, 1099s, K-1s, brokerage statements) and

requesting them from the client



5. Client Communication

• Responding to client
s directly in clear, professional written English

• Requesting documents, following up on outstanding items, and explaining bookkeeping

or tax questions at the client’s level

• Escalating anything sensitive or out-of-scope to me before responding

What This Role Does NOT Own

• Signing tax returns or providing tax advice (I review and sign)

• Sales, pricing, or new-client acquisition

• Hiring or firing decisions

• High-level client-relationship management on key accounts (I keep this)

Must-Haves (Non-Negotiable)

• 3+ years of bookkeeping experience in a US CPA or bookkeeping firm — not just BPO

data entry

• Hands-on experience preparing US tax returns in Intuit ProConnect (1040 + at least one

of 1065/1120-S/1120)

• QuickBooks Online proficiency — ProAdvisor certification strongly preferred

• Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills: pivot tables, SUMIFS, data filtering, INDEX/MATCH

and VLOOKUP. Do not apply if you are not confident in these.

• Professional, clear, client-ready written and spoken English (you will
 and call on

behalf of the firm)

• Comfortable calling US federal and state tax agencies and staying patient through long

holds

• Quiet home-office setup, reliable internet, and a working webcam (video interview

required)

• True full-time availability — this must be your primary job, not a side gig



Nice-to-Haves

• Experience with Gusto, ADP, or other US payroll platforms

• Experience with Karbon, TaxDome, or another practice-management tool

• Real-estate, e-commerce, or professional-services client experience

• Comfort using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) as part of a normal workflow

Hours & Communication

• 40 hours per week, fully remote

• Schedule is flexible — the work is what matters

• 1–2 weekly video check-ins with me at ~5:00 PM PST (Pacific Time)

• Daily async communication via
 and our project tool

• We are an AI-friendly firm. You may use Claude or ChatGPT as part of your workflow,

with strict rules about never putting client data into public AI tools without authorization

— I train you on this.



Not a Fit If

• Your written English is not yet client-ready

- Your spoken English is not fluent/client-ready

• You’ve only done BPO-style data entry and have never closed books or prepped a

return end-to-end

• You go quiet under deadline pressure instead of communicating

• You’re looking for a short contract or a side gig alongside another full-time employer



Compensation

$900 to $1200 a month depending on experience



How to Apply

 me directly at 
 this exact subject line, filling in the bracket:

ClearBooks Admin / Bookkeeper / Tax Preparer Application — [the part of this role that excites

you most]



In your
, include:

1. One sentence on what stood out to you in this posting, so I know you read it

2. A short intro on your bookkeeping and tax-prep background, including which US firm(s)

you’ve worked for and how long

3. The US tax forms you’ve prepared in ProConnect (1040, 1065, 1120-S, 1120, etc.) and

how many of each per season

4. Brief, honest answers (in your own words) to these four questions:

• How would you handle a client who is frustrated about a missed tax deadline?

• A client hasn’t reconciled their bank feed in 4 months and keeps dodging your

requests for statements. What do you do?

• Walk me through how you would call the IRS to resolve a CP2000 notice for a

client.

• Tell me about a complex bookkeeping or tax situation you handled well, and what

made it complex.

5. Confirmation that this would be your primary full-time job

6. Confirmation that you are comfortable on a video camera interview



To prove you read this carefully, include the word “tangerine” somewhere in your
 —

anywhere is fine.



Applications that ignore these instructions, skip the questions, or are obvious copy-paste will not

be considered. I read every serious application and respond to strong ones quickly.

mbers who are fluent in English. We provide a supportive working environment so that new employees can adapt quickly.

mbers will also provide guidance when needed.

- Check and reflect quotation materials received from domestic Korean suppliers

- Refer to existing ERP input records and enter data according to the company’s internal standards

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

- Manage quotation progress and related data in an organized manner

This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products.

- Degree or background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field

- Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, or mechanical products

[Preferred Experience]

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

- Experience handling quotations, purchase orders, invoices, or product lists

- Experience using ERP, inventory management, purchasing management, or quotation management systems

- Experience in trading, export/import, purchasing, sourcing, or overseas sales support

- Experience communicating with suppliers or organizing supplier quotation data

- Experience reviewing product catalogs, spec sheets, manuals, or technical documents

- Experience with electrical/electronic components, industrial products, or machinery

- Experience organizing data using Excel



[Who We Are Looking For]

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

- Can follow fixed formats and internal standards

- Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed

- Can refer to previous examples and apply the same standards consistently

- Can handle repetitive data entry tasks responsibly

- Has an interest in global trade and technical products

- Wants to grow with a Korea-based global business team

ERP input data may be used for quotation review, supplier communication, and future export decisions, so a responsible work attitude is very important.



[Training & Work Support]

New employees are not expected to handle everything alone from the beginning.

DYE provides the following training and support:

- Existing ERP input records accumulated over the past 4 years

- Educational tutorial videos to help understand the work

- A mentorship program to help new employees adapt quickly

- Guidance from internal tea
mbers

mber who understands the current workflow



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

- This position is open to both entry-level or junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to adapt to our internal systems and operational standards.

- Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.

Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.

- Exceptional performance may also lead to early promotions or salary increases prior to the annual review.

1. Regular Employee Benefits

2. Performance-Based Incentives

- Additional incentives may be provided during high-performance business periods or when performance is excellent.

3. Paid Holidays

4. Long Service Incentive Program

[How To Apply for the job]

Just Fill out 10 Simple Questions through Google Form

s or

This position plays an important role in accurately organizing overseas buyer inquiries and domestic supplier quotations for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products in the ERP system.



If you have a background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field, and you can handle documents and data carefully, you can successfully adapt to this role with DYE’s training and support.



As DYE plans to expand its global team with a focus on Filipino talent, this position offers the opportunity to grow into a larger role in the future.

title: B2B SDR Sales Development (Experienced level only) Business Insurance
description:
?? IMPORTANT — PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING ??

COMPANY: Insurance Sales Professionals | Inclusive Insurance

LOCATION: 100% Remote (Philippines-based applicants welcome)

HOURS: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM PST (U.S. Hours)

PAY: $6 USD/hour  COMMISSION: Commission plan available after successful trial period - Trial period is short for performers



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are a U.S.-based insurance Agency we are building a remote B2B outbound team. As an Appointment Setter / SDR, your job is to call business owners, HR managers, and decision-makers across the United States and start conversations about their company's current insurance coverage — 



we have many individual campaigns and focus on the following- areas:

Company Employee Benefits

Commercial Liability

Workers' Compensation

Retirement Plans (401k, 403(b) SEP)



You are NOT closing deals. You are opening doors. Your goal is to qualify prospects and book discovery calls for our licensed agents using a consultative, NEPQ-based sales approach. If NEPQ is new study up (an activity is outlined below)



WHAT YOU'LL DO EVERY DAY

- Make outbound B2B calls to U.S. business leads (warm and cold)

- Use NEPQ-style questions to uncover gaps in a company's current insurance coverage

- Qualify decision-makers and schedule discovery calls with our licensed agents

- Handle objections professionally and keep prospects engaged

- Log all call activity and notes in GoHighLevel or Zoho CRM

- Follow up consistently on pipeline contacts



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

? Strong English speaker with a minimal, neutral accent — this is NON-NEGOTIABLE

? Confident and clear on the phone — you must sound professional and trustworthy

? Experience in outbound B2B calling, cold calling, or appointment setting

? SDR, BDR, or telesales background strongly preferred

? Familiarity with CRM tools — GoHighLevel or Zoho CRM preferred

? Experience with dialers such as JustCall or Twilio is a plus

? CRM configuration experience is valued

? Self-motivated, target-driven, and disciplined

? Reliable high-speed internet connection and a quiet workspace

? Quality headset or microphone required



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- Consistently hitting your daily outbound call target

- Booking qualified appointments that show up and convert

- Maintaining a professional, consultative tone on every call

- Growing your commission earnings after the trial period



? HOW TO APPLY — FOLLOW THESE INSTRUCTIONS EXACTLY ?



We receive many applications. To be considered, your application MUST include ALL of the following:

1. YOUR RESUME — attach as PDF or paste your experience summary

2. A LOOM VIDEO (preferred) or voice note — Record yourself asking the following 3 NEPQ questions as if you are speaking to a business owner on a real call. Keep it natural, 2–3 minutes max. Paste your Loom link in your application message.



--- THE 3 NEPQ QUESTIONS TO RECORD on Loom or similar--- 



You are calling on our Employer Sponsored Employee Benefits Campaign.  You reach the Head of Human Resource after doing some research on the company.



Strong Opener: show you read a little about a strong opener using NEPQ... 



QUESTION 1 (Sample Situation Question):

"Right now, when it comes to the benefits you're offering your employees — things like health coverage, dental coverage or any kind of retirement plan — how satisfied are you with what you currently have in place, and how well do you feel it's actually working for your team?"  Then add two follow on questions assuming they say... no we are happy with our benefits. 



QUESTION 2 (Sample Problem Awareness):

"A lot of the business owners we speak with tell us that their biggest concern isn't the coverage itself — it's not knowing if they're actually protected when something goes wrong, like an employee injury or a liability claim. Is that something that's ever crossed your mind with your current policy?"



QUESTION 3 (Sample Consequence & Vision):

"If it turned out there were gaps in your current coverage — say in your workers' comp or your employee benefits package — and those gaps were quietly costing you either in employee retention or in out-of-pocket risk, how important would it be to you to get that looked at sooner rather than later?"



3. A BRIEF COVER MESSAGE — In 3–5 sentences, tell us: How many years of outbound B2B or phone sales experience you have, which CRM and dialer tools you've used, and why you'd be a great fit for this role.



4. ANY SALES RESULTS OR METRICS from a previous role (appointment rates, conversion numbers, etc.) — optional but strongly preferred.





? DO NOT APPLY IF:

- You are an agency, recruiter, or submitting on behalf of someone else

- You have a strong accent that affects your professional English communication

- You are not available for U.S. Pacific Time hours M-Friday

- Have multiple jobs 

- Have poor technology and rosters in the back yard 

- Noisy Fan

- Poor work ethic 

- You cannot submit a voice or video sample with your application

- Not money motivated we will offer a generous commission plan after we know you can be successful



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Thank you for your interest in joining our team.

title: Senior Bookkeeper (Full-Time) | US Firm, QBO ProAdvisor Required
description:
Are you an experienced bookkeeper who has worked for a US firm and is looking for a stable, long-term, full-time home instead of another short-term gig?



I'm Chris Kocina, owner of LivFree Bookkeeping, a US-based firm serving 30+ small-business clients. We're a small, tight team that values doing the work right over doing it fast. My values are stewardship, integrity, and service, and I run the business that way.



I'm hiring one experienced Senior Bookkeeper to own production for a set of clients and to grow with us long-term. This is a real seat on a small team, not a faceless data-entry pool.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- Full-cycle bookkeeping for assigned clients: bank and credit card reconciliations, GL maintenance, and month-end close

- Routine client
 communication: responding to updates, requesting documents, following up, and logging tasks in our client portal

- Hitting our firm-wide close deadlines on a defined close calendar

- Quality review support on a junior bookkeeper's work, under my direction

- Documenting processes as we build them (we record short Loom walkthroughs)

- Flagging complex or unusual client situations to me early



You won't be thrown in alone. You'll ramp into client communication over the first few weeks and work alongside our lead bookkeeper.



WHAT THIS ROLE DOES NOT OWN

- Sales or new client acquisition

- Pricing decisions

- Hiring or firing decisions

- High-level client relationship management (I keep this)



This is a senior production role with room to grow into more responsibility over time as you prove fit. I'm being honest that it is not a guaranteed manager title on day one.



MUST-HAVES (non-negotiable)

- 5+ years of bookkeeping experience

- QBO ProAdvisor certified (QuickBooks Online is the core of everything we do)

- You have worked for a US bookkeeping firm before, not just BPO data entry

- You have independently closed books for multiple clients

- Professional, clear written English (you will be
ing clients directly)

- True full-time availability. This must be your primary job, not a side gig.



NICE-TO-HAVES (a plus, not required)

- Experience with Double (formerly Keeper), Gusto, or Ramp

- Construction or job-costing experience

- Comfort using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) in your daily workflow



HOW WE WORK

We are an AI-first firm. Every tea
mber uses AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT as a normal part of their work to ensure efficiency and accuracy. If that excites you, you'll fit right in. We have clear rules about never putting client data into public AI tools without authorization, and we train you on this.



NOT A FIT IF

- You want a side gig or are juggling another full-time employer

- You prefer pure task execution and don't want to own outcomes

- Your written English is not yet client-ready

- You go quiet when things get busy instead of communicating



THE SETUP

- Long-term, full-time role (40 hrs/week), not a short contract

- Remote, Philippines-based, flexible schedule with some daily overlap to US Central Time

- We start with a paid 2-week trial. During the trial, you connect securely from your own computer into our company system, so no client data is ever stored on your personal machine. Once you pass the trial, we ship you a fully configured company laptop with all your tools installed.

- 1099 independent contractor arrangement

- Structured onboarding and training in your first weeks, with 30-day and 90-day check-ins



COMPENSATION

$11 to $13 per hour USD to start, depending on experience. I review compensation at your 90-day mark and as your responsibilities grow. Strong performance is rewarded here. The better you do and the more you own, the more you earn. I want this to be a long-term home, and I pay people accordingly.



HOW TO APPLY

 me directly at 
 this exact subject line, filling in the bracket:

LivFree Senior Bookkeeper Application, [name the part of this role that excites you most]



In your
, include:

1. One sentence on what stood out to you in this posting, so I know you read it

2. A short intro on your bookkeeping background, including which US firm(s) you've worked for

3. Brief answers, in your own words, to these four questions:



- How would you handle a client frustrated about a missed deadline?

- A client hasn't reconciled their bank feed in 4 months and keeps dodging your requests for statements. How do you handle it?

- You're reviewing a junior bookkeeper's work and notice recurring errors in their bank reconciliations. How do you address it with them?

- Tell me about a complex client situation you handled well.

5. Confirmation that this would be your primary full-time job





I read every serious application and respond to strong ones quickly. Applications that ignore these instructions or skip the questions won't be considered.

title: Cold Caller/ Appt Setter (Real Estate / Vacant Land) — Remote
description:
Cold Caller (Real Estate / Vacant Land) — Remote



The Land Pioneer | Hiring 6–10 | Apply: 



Heads up: this listing is long on purpose. We need you to read it. There are instructions buried inside that tell us whether you actually did. Skim and you're out.





Who we are:



The Land Pioneer (
) is a vacant land acquisitions and dispositions business. We buy raw land at a discount, then sell it. Cold calling is the engine of our pipeline — without great callers, nothing else moves.



Who we're looking for:



We're hiring 6–10 cold callers who already know how to sell. We are NOT going to train you on:



How to handle objections:



How to build rapport in the first 15 seconds

What a motivated seller actually sounds like

Why "just thinking about it" isn't a real objection



If you're early in your sales career and looking for someone to teach you scripts and tonality, this isn't the role. We need experienced callers — people who can pick up a phone, navigate a conversation, keep a stranger on the line, and know within two minutes whether the person on the other end is a real lead, a maybe, or a tire-kicker. You should be able to filter hot from cold without us looking over your shoulder.



Must-haves:



Real estate cold calling experience in the US market. Vacant land experience is a major plus and will likely earn you a higher starting rate.



Neutral or American accent with strong English fluency. You should sound like someone a US homeowner would comfortably talk to for ten minutes without feeling like they're on a "sales call."



A proven track record. We will ask for references and metrics — dials per day, contact rates, qualified leads passed, deals sourced.



Recorded calls we can listen to. Non-negotiable. If you don't have them, don't apply. Redact PII where needed, but we want to hear you in action — wins and tough calls both.



Reliable internet, a quality headset, a quiet workspace, and the ability to overlap with US time zones.



Adaptability. Our process evolves. We test scripts, swap list sources, refine criteria. You should welcome that, not resist it.



What you'll be doing:



Calling property owners from lists we provide

Use our software to look at the property features

Provide range offers to the sellers (After training)

Building rapport quickly, finding motivation, qualifying or disqualifying fast

Passing warm, vetted leads to our acquisitions team

Logging clean notes in our CRM

Hitting daily and weekly KPIs on dials, contacts, and qualified leads



Compensation:



Hourly base



Junior callers (less experience but strong fundamentals): $4/hr

Seasoned callers (verifiable track record, especially in land): higher base — we'll discuss based on what you bring



Acquisition bonus:



For Junior Cold Callers: $75 paid as soon as a deal closes on the acquisitions side from a lead you sourced. This applies during probation and continues after.



For Experienced Cold Callers: $150 paid as soon as a deal closes on the acquisitions side from a lead you sourced. This applies during probation and continues after.



After 90 days (post-probation)



You graduate onto our tier-based back-end comp plan. When a deal you sourced closes full cycle — meaning we've bought it AND sold it on the dispositions side — you get paid out of the sales funds when they hit our account. This is where the real money is for our long-term callers. We're not playing games with comp; when we win, you win.





How to apply — read carefully, this IS the filter



 
 with everything below. Missing pieces get your application moved to the trash.



1. Subject line — use this exact format: Cold Caller Application — [Your Name] — [Years of RE Cold Calling Experience]



2. The very first line of your
 body must read: I read the whole post — here's my pitch. If this line is missing, you don't make it to the next round. We mean it.



3. Attach or link the following:



Your resume (PDF preferred)



2–3 recorded cold calls. At least one should be a call where you turned a cold or skeptical prospect into a real conversation. Add a one-line note telling us what to listen for.



A Loom video, 3–5 minutes max, introducing yourself and walking us through (a) what you know about the US real estate industry and (b) what you know — or want to learn — about vacant land specifically. Talk to the camera the way you'd talk to a seller. We're evaluating presence, not just content.



4. In the body of the
, answer these three questions briefly:



What's the #1 thing you do in the first 20 seconds of a cold call to keep someone on the line?



Tell us about a deal you sourced that you're proud of — what made the seller motivated, and how did you uncover it?



What's a real estate or land-specific term you've used on a call recently, and how did you use it? (We want to hear you actually speak the language.)



5. At the very bottom of your
, write one sentence about something on 
 that stood out to you. One sentence is enough — we just want to know you looked.





What happens next:



We review applications in the order they come in. If your call recordings and Loom land, we'll set up an interview. If that goes well, you're in — and we move fast. We're aiming to onboard all 6–10 hires within the next few weeks.



We're not the right fit for everyone. But if you're a real cold caller who's tired of being underpaid, micromanaged, or handed scripts you didn't help build — we'd love to hear from you.



Newman The Land Pioneer

description:
Company Overview



The Compliance Services Organization didn't exist. We built it.



MP1 Solutions pioneered the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined compliance programs for decades. Built on the foundation of MedPro Disposal, the nation's largest privately-held medical waste company serving 35,000+ providers across 48 states over the past 15 years, MP1 Solutions extends that operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading. We're doing it with a technology-forward approach, actively developing the AI infrastructure that will make this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow.



What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice's behalf.



Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We're changing that — and we're looking for people who want to help build what comes next.



Our technology: We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place.



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. Position Overview:

The Manager, Billing & Financial Operations is the operational owner of MedPro Disposal and MP1 Solutions' non-CA financial transaction engine — the function that ensures every invoice goes out accurately, every payment gets applied, every vendor gets paid, and every manifest and billing record is reconciled and audit-ready.

Billing Operations & Transaction Processing

• Own end-to-end billing operations — from invoice generation through delivery, dispute resolution, and closed-loop reconciliation across all MedPro and MP1 service lines

• Build and maintain the performance scorecard for the team: accuracy rate, turnaround time, DSO, collection rate, and AP aging metrics — with visible accountability at every level

title: Creative Operations Coordinator (Workflow & Delivery Tracking)
description:
About us



Drippl is a performance creative agency. We produce ad creatives at scale for around 15 DTC brands across Europe. Everything runs through a structured system in Notion, with tickets, editors, and pods. We move fast and ship a high volume of creative every single week.



Why we are hiring



With this much volume, things occasionally slip. A ticket gets created and then sits. An editor quietly gets overloaded. A deliverable runs late and nobody notices until the client asks. We need one person whose entire job is to make sure that never happens.



The role



You are the person who watches the whole system, all day, and makes sure nothing gets lost. You are not making the creative. You are tracking it, chasing it, and reporting on it.



Day to day you will:





Keep a live overview of every active ticket and deliverable across all clients

Spot anything overdue or stuck (for example: "this ticket was created 14 days ago and is still not done") and flag it to the editor responsible

Follow up until the ticket moves, politely but persistently

Watch editor workload and tell the founders when someone is carrying too many tickets, so we can hire ahead of the bottleneck instead of after it

Keep the Notion board clean and accurate so it always reflects reality

Send the founders a short daily or weekly summary of what is on track, what is at risk, and what is blocked





You are a good fit if you





Are extremely detail oriented and genuinely bothered when something is late or out of place

Are proactive. You chase, you do not wait to be asked

Communicate clearly and professionally in written English (you will be pinging editors and reporting to founders)

Are comfortable holding people accountable in a friendly but firm way

Are reliable and consistent. This is a "show up every day and keep the system clean" role

Are comfortable following up on people and keeping a strong, accurate overview of output across the whole team





Notion is a must (not optional)



This is a hard requirement. You need strong, real knowledge of:





Notion itself

Notion databases (relations, filters, views, properties)

Notion dashboards





We have built many dashboards in Notion to track the factors that matter most to us, and you will live inside them every day. Beyond tracking, we want someone who knows Notion well enough to help us improve and optimize these dashboards and databases over time. If you only know Notion casually, this is not the role for you.



Bonus points





Experience in a creative agency, marketing team, or any ticket or project based environment

Familiarity with creative or video production workflows

Background as a project coordinator, traffic manager, or operations VA





Details





Paid per hour

We start small, a few hours per day, with clear room to scale up your hours as you prove yourself and the role grows

Timezone: [overlap needed, e.g. a few hours of CET overlap per day]

Long term role with room to grow as we scale the team





How to apply





Start your application with the word OVERSIGHT so we know you actually read this

Submit your portfolio, especially any Notion databases or dashboards you have built or managed

Tell us your years of experience with Notion and with tracking or coordinating work

Tell us your expected hourly rate

Tell us about a time you caught something that was about to slip through the cracks, and what you did about it





Applications that skip these steps will not be reviewed.

Company Overview



The Compliance Services Organization didn't exist. We built it.



MP1 Solutions pioneered the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined compliance programs for decades. Built on the foundation of MedPro Disposal, the nation's largest privately-held medical waste company serving 35,000+ providers across 48 states over the past 15 years, MP1 Solutions extends that operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading. We're doing it with a technology-forward approach, actively developing the AI infrastructure that will make this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow.



What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice's behalf.



Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We're changing that — and we're looking for people who want to help build what comes next.



Our technology: We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place.



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. And unlike a traditional vendor relationship, our model is designed to get better over time — continuously re-evaluated, optimized, and improved with every client we serve.



Position Overview:

The Billing Support Analyst is the financial backbone of MedPro Disposal’s client lifecycle — ensuring every account is billed accurately, every discrepancy is resolved promptly, and every month-end close is executed without gaps. This role is designed for a tenured billing professional who owns their work end-to-end: from new account setup and billing audits to specialty program management and inbox triage, with the precision and autonomy that keeps the organization’s revenue engine running clean. Success means zero billing errors reaching clients, faster resolution cycles, and a finance team that can scale confidently because its foundation is airtight.

1.  New Customer Set-Up

? Third-party hauler over-allotment

? Pharmaceutical billing

? Hazardous waste billing

? Other applicable service types as assigned

• Support mailback program billing and related finance tasks as assigned.



4.  Billing Inbox Management

• Monitor the billing inbox daily, triaging and routing incoming requests to the appropriate tea
mber or queue.

• Communicate with internal teams — including Sales, Operations, and Customer Service — to resolve account setup questions and billing discrepancies.



5.  Month-End Close Support

• Assist with month-end close activities including charge posting, invoice review, and reconciliation tasks.

• Pull invoices and account data to support close reporting and ad-hoc management requests within defined turnaround windows.



6.  Specialty Billing Account Support

• Support billing operations for specialty accounts, adhering to each account’s unique invoicing rules, contract terms, and reporting requirements.

• Ensure accuracy and timeliness across specialty program billing cycles, including:

? Premise

? Humana

? Conviva

? Tempus

? Additional specialty accounts as assigned

title: Financial Controller
description:
Ikigai Cases is hiring a Controller!

Location: Remote / Work From Home

Reports to: CEO





About the Company

Ikigai Cases (
) is a fast-growing ecommerce brand manufacturing aerospace-grade aluminum pill cases. Founded in December 2021 by two brothers after their father’s neurological diagnosis led them to discovering the issues with plastic pill organizers, we’ve built a multi-million dollar business in just over four years with a team of 25 across the globe.



Our mission is simple: make exceptional pill cases and provide exceptional customer service. We deliver on this by managing in-house fulfillment at our Washington, DC facility (including custom engraving) and maintaining obsessive attention to detail.





About the Role

We are hiring a Controller to take complete ownership of our financial operations - accounting, reporting, payroll, budgeting, cash flow, tax coordination, and financial systems. This is a critical senior role, and we’re looking for someone whose professional identity is built around three things: the integrity of the numbers, running the finance function end-to-end, and providing strategic financial insight to the CEO.



The ideal candidate has served as a Controller (or equivalent) for an e-commerce or DTC brand in the $10–30M revenue range. You understand the financial rhythms of e-commerce: Shopify revenue recognition, inventory accounting, seasonal cash flow swings, sales tax across multiple states, and the speed at which decisions need to be made. If you’ve done this before at a similar-sized company, you already know what we need.



At $11.5M in revenue and targeting $30M by 2028, our financial complexity is outpacing our financial infrastructure. We need someone who builds systems, not just operates inside them. You’ll report directly to the CEO and work hand-in-hand with our external financial advisor. No layers of management between you and the decisions your work supports.









Core Responsibilities

Monthly Close & Financial Reporting: Close books by the 10th of every month. Produce reviewed P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statements in Finaloop. Resolve misclassifications proactively. Maintain a clean chart of accounts. No CEO intervention required.



Budgeting & Financial Planning: Prepare and maintain monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets. Own budget vs. actuals: produce variance reports monthly alongside the P&L close with plain-language explanations. Update balance sheet items and expenses weekly inside the company’s financial models.



Cash Flow Management & Forecasting: Maintain the 13-week cash flow forecast weekly and proactively. Flag upcoming cash movements, exposure, and risks before they become surprises. This is one of the most critical tools the CEO uses for capital allocation.



Payroll Operations (Zero-Error Standard): Own bi-weekly payroll across ADP (US) and Deel (Philippines). Submit the morning of payroll day, every cycle. PTO, overtime, and deductions captured before submission. You catch discrepancies before they reach the CEO.



Tax Coordination & Compliance: Own the relationship with Numeral on multi-state sales tax filings. Maintain the estimated tax payment tracker. Coordinate with our external CPA on annual filings. Flag tax exposure and timing proactively.

Vendor Payments, Disbursements & Financial Systems: Execute and double-check all vendor payments (Venmo, PayPal, wire). Track owner distributions and related-party transactions. Manage Finaloop, Shopify revenue reconciliation, and Google Sheets financial modeling. Manage financial admin including insurance, vendor accounts, and benefits.



CEO Reporting & Ad Hoc Analysis: Weekly: 13WCF update, flagged variances, upcoming cash movements. Monthly: clean financial statements with brief narrative. As needed: ad hoc financial analysis without requiring a detailed spec.



Why You Should Take This Role

-You’ll work at a brand obsessed with its customers, with a loyal following. Read the reviews: 
/pages/reviews

-A company that’s scaled rapidly in 4 years and is aggressively investing in growth.

-You’ll work hand-in-hand with the founder, not through layers of management, with full autonomy to own your domain.

-The company was founded to solve a personal problem - Tavish’s father battled a neurological condition for a decade and the family discovered the issues with plastic pill organizers.

-You’ll own the entire financial function for a company on a trajectory from $11.5M to $30M - a career-defining role for the right person.





Required Experience & Skills

-5+ years in accounting, bookkeeping, or finance operations

-Prior Controller or senior finance role at a company doing $10M+ in annual revenue - you’ve owned the full financial function, not just pieces of it

-E-commerce or DTC company experience strongly preferred - Shopify revenue recognition, inventory accounting, seasonal cash flow, multi-state sales tax

-Experience closing books independently, on a monthly cadence, without supervision

-Demonstrated accuracy record - you should be able to speak to this specifically

-US GAAP familiarity (CPA not required, but you must understand the principles)

-Experience preparing monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets

-Payroll experience across multiple platforms

-Advanced Google Sheets / Excel (SUMIFS, financial modeling, pivot tables)

-Strong proficiency with Finaloop, QuickBooks Online, or equivalent cloud accounting platform

-Strong written and verbal English; ability to explain financial insights to non-financial stakeholders





Nice-to-Have Experience

-Experience working remotely for a US-based company from the Philippines

-Exposure to sales tax compliance across multiple US states

-Experience using Notion (or similar task management software)

-EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) familiarity

-Prior experience coordinating with external CPAs and tax advisors





What We’re Really Looking For

-Technical skills get you in the door. These traits determine whether you succeed:

-Detail orientation as professional pride - you catch your own errors before they go out, and you change your process so they don’t recur.

-Proactive disclosure - you surface problems before being asked, even when it’s uncomfortable.

-Ownership without supervision - if it’s due, it’s done. No prompting required.

-Direct communication - you push back when something doesn’t look right.

-Reliability - when you say you’ll be available, you’re available. When you can’t be, you say so immediately.





Compensation Details & Schedule

-Compensation: TBD based on candidate experience. Target compensation will be requested during screening.

-Work Hours: 50 hours/week, Monday–Friday. Core overlap with US Eastern hours (9AM–5PM EST).

-Paid Holidays: 10 paid holidays per year

-PTO: 1 week earned for every 6 months worked at the company

-Location: Remote / Work From Home

title: Logistics Specialist
description:
LOGISTICS SPECIALIST — AFTERNOON/EVENING SHIFT



Remote | Full-Time | $4–$6 USD/hour

Location: Fully Remote



Schedule: 5 Days/Week + Optional 6th Day



Pay Rate: $4–$6 USD/hour



Language: English (Fluent)



ABOUT THE COMPANY

SDA Global Inc. is a US-based time-critical logistics company specializing in same-day air cargo, expedited freight, and last-mile delivery solutions. We serve clients across multiple industries and operate with carriers and contractors throughout North America and beyond. We pride ourselves on speed, reliability, and exceptional customer communication.



ROLE OVERVIEW

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Logistics Specialist to join our afternoon/evening operations team remotely. This role is designed for candidates who already have a foundation in logistics, freight, customer service, or a related field. We will provide structured training on our systems, workflows, and industry terminology, but we expect candidates to arrive with relevant experience and the ability to apply it quickly.

Important note on schedule: This is an afternoon/evening shift role operating from 3:00 PM to 11:00 PM Central Time (CT). For candidates based in the Philippines, this translates to approximately 4:00 AM – 12:00 PM Philippine Time (PHT) — a regular morning schedule.

Training Period: During your first month, training will be conducted on the overnight schedule (11:00 PM – 7:00 AM CT) alongside our existing operations team. This is a hands-on, immersive training period designed to get you fully up to speed before transitioning to your permanent afternoon/evening shift.

Trial Period: Following training, you will enter a 2-month mutual trial period on the afternoon/evening shift. This period is designed for both you and SDA Global Inc. to evaluate fit, performance, and long-term alignment before a permanent arrangement is confirmed.

The position is 5 days per week, and at least one of those days must be a Saturday or Sunday. Candidates who are not available on weekends will not be considered. An optional 6th day is available for agents who want to earn additional income — agents who take the extra day will always retain at least one weekend day off.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Monitor and coordinate time-critical shipments and provide real-time status updates to clients

Communicate professionally with customers, carriers, and contractors via
 and phone

Assist with driver dispatching, scheduling, and breakdown coordination

Process and manage shipping documentation including AWBs, BOLs, and PODs

Enter and track job information accurately in our internal systems

Follow up on shipment exceptions and escalate issues to the operations supervisor

Support the team with administrative logistics tasks as needed





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Prior experience in logistics, freight, customer service, or a related field — this is required

Fluent, professional English — both written and spoken (non-negotiable)

Strong attention to detail and excellent organizational skills

Reliable internet connection and a quiet, professional remote work environment

Availability for the training period overnight schedule (11:00 PM – 7:00 AM CT) during the first month

Availability for the permanent afternoon/evening shift (3:00 PM – 11:00 PM CT) following training

Must be available to cover at least one weekend day (Saturday or Sunday) — firm and non-negotiable

Optional 6th day available for agents who wish to earn extra income — you will always retain at least one weekend day off

Fast learner who takes initiative and is coachable

Calm, professional demeanor under pressure — logistics moves fast





WHAT WE OFFER



Structured 1-month training period on our overnight team before transitioning to your permanent shift

2-month mutual trial period to ensure the role is the right fit for both parties

Stable, long-term remote position with a US-based company

Competitive pay of $4–$6 USD/hour based on experience and skill level

Supportive team environment with direct access to experienced operations staff

Opportunity to grow within the company as skills develop

* Your resume or CV (in English)

"A customer calls asking for an update on their shipment. You check the system and see that the flight was delayed by 3 hours. How do you proceed?"



Candidates who pass the initial review will be invited to a short paid trial task before a final hiring decision is made.



SDA Global Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

title: SOCIAL MEDIA VIDEO EDITOR / CONTENT CREATOR (LONG-TERM, WORK FROM HOME)
description:
Hi there ????

 

Meal Boosters is a fast-growing brand making savory, high-protein food and supplements, with 50,000+ happy customers and a loyal community behind us. We've also built a huge library of content in-house and with our ambassadors. We've got the raw material. Now we're looking for the right creative person to turn it into scroll-stopping content across TikTok, Instagram,
, and YouTube Shorts.

 

Here's the fun part: our product is new to its category, so this isn't the same recycled supplement content you've seen a hundred times. You get fresh creative territory to play in, and content built around something genuinely different tends to stand out in the feed on its own. We're growing fast, and this is a real chance to get in early and help shape how the brand shows up online.

 

If you live and breathe short-form video, you actually enjoy watching what's trending, and you get a little thrill out of a video taking off, keep reading. This could be a great long-term home for you.

 

 

WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING

 

- Pulling from our existing UGC library and editing it into fresh, platform-native content

- Supplementing with AI tools and B-roll when a clip needs a little extra

- Creating content built for each platform, not the same video posted four times. TikTok should feel like TikTok; a YouTube Short should feel like a Short

- Staying on top of trends (sounds, formats, hooks, editing styles) and weaving them into our content

- Working from our weekly briefs, but also bringing your own ideas to the table. We want your creativity, not just your hands on the keyboard

 

WHAT WE'LL GIVE YOU

 

- Clear brand guidelines so you always know our look, voice, and feel

- Product education so the content is accurate and genuinely good

- Full access to our content library

- A weekly brief covering anything specific we're focused on that week

- Room to experiment and make the content your own

 

YOU'LL BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU

 

- Have real experience editing short-form video (please show us!)

- Know your way around tools like CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, or similar

- Are comfortable using AI tools (Runway, Descript, ElevenLabs, image generators) to enhance content

- Understand what makes each platform tick, and how a "good" video differs from TikTok to Reels to Shorts

- Have an eye for hooks, pacing, captions, and the small details that make people stop scrolling

- Are reliable, communicate clearly, and take feedback well

- Bring ideas, not just execution

 

Bonus points if you've worked with a DTC, e-commerce, or consumer brand before.

 

WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

 

This is a long-term role, and we're genuinely looking for someone we want on the team for the long haul. When we connect, we'll walk through exactly how we like to start working together and make sure it's a great fit on both sides.

 

HOW TO APPLY (please read carefully)

 

We read every application, and the details matter to us. To apply:

 

1. Start your message with the word GREENLIGHT so we know you read this all the way through.

2. Share 2 to 3 links to short-form videos you've edited or created (TikTok, Reels, Shorts, or a portfolio, whatever shows your range).

3. In a few sentences, tell us about a recent trend you used in your content and why it worked.

4. List the editing and AI tools you're most comfortable with.

 

We're excited to see what you've got. Talented, creative people who love this work tend to really enjoy it here, and we'd love for that to be you.

s, and social media DMs on a 30/60/90 day sequence

s, and DMs combined.

GoHighLevel CRM — texts and
s with templates provided

Social media DMs —

Commission-only. You earn when deals close. Here's the floor — no ceiling on performance:

Closed buyer transaction originating from your pipeline — 3% of gross commission earned

Closed seller listing transaction originating from your pipeline — 2.5% of gross commission earned

Qualified appointment that shows and converts to a consultation — $25 bonus per appointment

What the math looks like:

Standard close — OKC buyer transaction at $6,000 gross commission = $180 for the ISA. Strong close — OKC buyer transaction at $15,000 gross commission = $450 for the ISA. 5 closes in a month at the standard floor = $900 in transaction commission. Add 10 qualified appointments at $25 each and your realistic floor month is $1,150 — while your pipeline is still building.

OKC average transaction values are climbing — the floor is the minimum, not the typical. There is no ceiling on what this looks like as the pipeline grows and your volume increases.

CST availability is a competitive edge — you're working deals in real time while other remote ISAs are asleep.

title: Senior AI Automation Engineer | n8n + Ollama + Mac Studio Agent Builds
description:
Good catch. Stripped the dollar figures and replaced with neutral framing that still conveys "real client work, real stakes" without giving applicants leverage on what you bill.



JOB TITLE: Senior AI Automation Engineer | Build Multi-Agent Swarm on Mac Studio + Subscription Business OS

SALARY: $8 to $10 per hour USD to start, calibrated to demonstrated experience after technical assessment. Senior engineers move toward $15+ per hour as they take full ownership of build delivery.

HOURS: 40 hours per week, full time, long term

SCHEDULE: Overlap with US Eastern Time required (at least 4 hours daily)

TYPE: Direct hire. Not agency, not freelance, not project based.



ABOUT VIRAL GROWTH MEDIA

Viral Growth Media is a Tampa, Florida based digital media and AI automation company. We build full operating systems for high-revenue subscription, creator, and service businesses. We have an in-house Mac Studio M3 Ultra (512GB unified memory, 8TB SSD) ready to host a multi-agent AI swarm on n8n, Ollama, and botctl. We are not hiring you to maintain a running system. We are hiring you to build it.

YOUR TWO PROJECTS

You are not being hired to float across an open queue of small tasks. You are being hired for two named builds with defined scope, defined timelines, and defined deliverables. Both are greenfield. You are building them from zero.

Project 1: Build the Internal Multi-Agent Swarm on Mac Studio M3 Ultra (Greenfield)

The hardware is sitting and ready. The architecture is specified. You are building the system.



Stand up the Mac Studio M3 Ultra as a production inference host. Install and configure Ollama, n8n, and botctl. Lock down system access.

Build the 6-agent swarm from scratch. Each agent has a defined role (content generation, sales triage, monitoring, orchestration, and two more we will brief you on at intake). You will be selecting the right local LLM per agent workload (not just running one default model)

Build inter-agent communication, queue management, retry logic, and persistent memory layers

Build the observability layer: agent uptime, token throughput, queue depth, error rates, escalation triggers

Set up secure remote dev access (Tailscale or Cloudflare Tunnel) so this stack is operable without physical access to the machine

Document the entire swarm architecture so the rest of the team can operate it without you in the room



Project 2: Client Operating System Build (subscription business)

This is an active client engagement currently in proposal stage with a multi-month delivery timeline. You will be the technical lead on delivery. Scope includes:



Helpdesk migration off a legacy phone-based system onto a real ticketing platform (Help Scout, Freshdesk, or Gorgias) with an AI first-touch agent trained on the client's actual three-year support history

Knowledge base extraction and structured documentation

Internal operator dashboard with real-time visibility: active users, trial conversion, failed payments, support volume, app outages, daily revenue

Payment-to-panel middleware between payment processors (Stripe, 
, NMI gateways, Easy Pay Direct, Durango) and the client's dashboard layer

Multi-processor failover architecture so a single processor shutdown does not take the business offline

Automated dunning with retry queues and SMS +
 recovery sequences

Automated renewal processing, onboarding agent, trial follow-up, cancellation save flow

Customer database migration, deduplication, and clean-up



THE STACK YOU WILL WORK IN

n8n (workflow orchestration), Ollama (local LLM inference on Mac Studio), GoHighLevel (CRM, workflows, IG bot, tags), ActiveCampaign 
 deliverability), Whop (community, payments, gated content), Twilio (SMS, A2P compliant), Asana (project management), Google Workspace.

You will be writing JavaScript and Python inside n8n nodes. You will be calling local Ollama endpoints from n8n. You will be building webhook bridges between GHL, ActiveCampaign, Whop, Stripe, and custom panels. You will sometimes be touching raw API calls when n8n nodes are insufficient.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



3+ years building automation workflows in n8n, Make (Integromat), or Zapier with measurable production output

Direct experience deploying local LLMs (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, or similar). You should be able to tell us which models you have run, on what hardware, and what you learned about prompt latency

Strong JavaScript and Python. You write code, you do not just connect nodes

Direct experience with at least 2 of: GoHighLevel, ActiveCampaign, Stripe API, Twilio API, Whop API

Webhook architecture, REST API integration, JSON debugging, async error handling

English fluent enough to write client-facing documentation. You will be writing SOPs in Asana that paying clients will read



STRONGLY PREFERRED



Experience designing and shipping multi-agent architectures from scratch (CrewAI, AutoGen, LangGraph, or custom n8n agent swarms)

Payment integration experience with US merchant accounts and multi-processor failover architecture

Has built customer-facing AI support agents in production (not demos)

Has worked inside a Mac Studio or Mac Pro environment remotely via SSH or Tailscale

Has set up Tailscale or Cloudflare Tunnel for remote dev access to local infrastructure



WHO YOU ARE NOT

This is not for someone who has only watched n8n tutorials and built one workflow. It is not for someone whose only LLM experience is calling the OpenAI API. It is not for someone who has only ever maintained other people's infrastructure and has never stood one up from scratch. If your portfolio is screenshots of templates instead of production systems you have built and operate, this is not the role.

WHO YOU ARE

You build infrastructure from zero. You read a business and immediately see the leak points. You write clean docs because future-you and the rest of the team will read them. You ship work without being chased.

COMPENSATION AND GROWTH



Starting rate: 13 per hour USD negotiable based on experience, calibrated after technical assessment

Weekly pay

Paid holidays after 90 days

Formal performance reviews at 60 days, 6 months, then annually

Senior engineers move toward $15+ per hour as they take full ownership of build delivery

Direct line to the founder. No middle management layer.



HOW TO APPLY

We screen aggressively. Generic applications go straight to the archive. Follow these steps exactly.



Subject line must read: AGENT SWARM BUILD | [Your Full Name]

In the body of your application, answer the following in this exact order:



One paragraph on the most complex n8n workflow you have built in production. What did it do, what stack did it touch, what broke, and how did you fix it?

One paragraph on local LLM deployment from scratch. Which model, which hardware, which use case, and what was the bottleneck?

List the APIs you have integrated directly (not via no-code tools).

Your hours of availability in US Eastern Time.

Your current monthly billing rate or salary expectation in USD.





Attach or link to:



GitHub or GitLab profile (or equivalent code repo)

At least one screen recording (Loom is fine) of you walking through an n8n workflow you built. Two minutes is enough. Show the actual canvas, not marketing slides.

Any client testimonial or written reference





Do not send a generic resume PDF as your only application.



Applications that do not follow this format will not be reviewed. We get hundreds of applicants per posting. The filter is the test.

We are hiring one person for this role. Project 1 kickoff is immediate on hire. Project 2 kickoff follows shortly after.

- LinkedIn article snippets

- YouTube Shorts

- Maintain a content repurposing calendar to track what's been created and where it's been posted

- Leverage user-generated content (UGC) with proper permissions and attribution



4. Content Gathering & Posting SOP



Phase 1: Content Sourcing

Identify content sources:

- User testimonials and success stories (via in-app surveys,
, DMs)

- Product updates and feature releases

- Wellness tips and educational content

- Team insights and behind-the-scenes 
nts

- Industry news and trending wellness topics

- Recorded webinars, workout sessions, and tutorials

- Assign responsibility for gathering content 



Phase 2: Content Review & Approval

- Review all content for brand alignment, accuracy, and compliance

- Obtain necessary approvals from marketing lead or founder before posting

- Verify permissions for user testimonials, images, and footage

- Check for quality standards (audio, lighting, captions, resolution)



Phase 3: Content Preparation

- Write captions and copy using Fitster's tone of voice (friendly, fun, accountable)

- Add relevant hashtags for discoverability (#wellness, #fitster, #busyprofessionals, etc.)

- Design graphics or edit videos as needed

- Create platform-specific variations (e.g., Instagram caption vs. LinkedIn post)

- Add CTAs (calls-to-action) aligned with current growth goals



Phase 4: Scheduling & Publishing



- Schedule posts 3–7 days in advance 

- Document post details in a master spreadsheet (date, platform, content type, link, performance metrics)

- Publish at optimal times based on audience analytics

- Pin important posts (announcements, launches) for extended visibility

- Phase 5: Monitoring & Optimization

- Track performance (likes, comments, shares, saves, reach, engagement rate)

- Identify top-performing content and themes for future ideation

- Adjust strategy based on monthly analytics reviews



Platforms & Posting Frequency



Instagram - 2–3x/week (Reels, Stories, Carousel, Static Posts)

Engagement & Awareness



 - 2–3x/week - Videos, Articles, Community Posts

Community Building



TikTok - 2–3x/week - Short-form Videos, Trends, Challenges

Viral Reach & Youth Audience



YouTube - 1–2x/week - Tutorials, Testimonials, Shorts

Education & Authority





Key Deliverables

? Weekly content calendar (themes, posting schedule, platform breakdown)

? Monthly performance report (engagement metrics, top posts, audience growth)

? Documented SOP (step-by-step process for content gathering, approval, and posting)

? Batch-scheduled posts (minimum 2 weeks ahead)

? Community engagement (responses to comments and DM notifications)

? Quarterly strategy review (adjustments based on performance and business goals)



Success Metrics

- Engagement Rate: Target 3–5% average across platforms

- Follower Growth: 10–15% monthly growth (adjusted by platform maturity)

- Click-Through Rate (CTR): Track traffic from social to app/website

- Conversion Tracking: Monitor free-to-premium signups attributed to social campaigns

- Content Repurposing Ratio: Minimum 3 pieces of content per original footage/asset

- Response Time: Reply to comments/DMs within 24 hours



Tools & Resources

- Analytics Platforms: Instagram Insights,
 
, LinkedIn Analytics, TikTok Analytics, YouTube Studio

- Content Creation: Canva, Adobe Creative Suite (or similar), CapCut for video editing

- Organization: Shared spreadsheet or project management tool (Notion, Trello, Asana)

- Brand Assets: Logo, color palette, font guidelines, brand voice document

- Content Library: Centralized folder for footage, images, testimonials, and approved content



Reporting & Communication

- Bi-Weekly sync: Brief check-in on content calendar and upcoming posts

- Monthly review: Performance analysis and strategy adjustments

- Quarterly planning: Content strategy refresh and goal setting

- Ad-hoc updates: Urgent announcements or trending opportunities



Notes

This scope assumes the Social Media Manager works closely with the founder (Shawn) and marketing lead (Jaemar) and has access to Fitster's content library, brand guidelines, and product team for timely updates. Flexibility is key—the role should adapt to emerging trends, seasonal 
nts, and product launches while maintaining brand consistency.
