title: Senior Sales Manager / Commercial Lead
description:
JVDB Studios | Amsterdam, Netherlands



Location: Remote (Philippines)

Schedule: Monday to Friday

Hours: 20 hours per week to start (Part-Time) with the opportunity to scale to 40 hours per week based on performance

Time Zone: Must have overlap with European/CET business hours

Compensation: Competitive base salary + uncapped commission



About JVDB Studios



JVDB Studios is a media and technology company based in Amsterdam, Netherlands. We are the team behind some of the world's largest creator brands, including Kwebbelkop and BlooGaming, which collectively reach more than 15 million subscribers globally.



Our CEO has built multiple successful digital businesses, generated billions of views across platforms, and continues to expand into new ventures within content, technology, licensing, and media distribution.



We are looking for a highly driven Senior Sales Manager / Commercial Lead who can take ownership of revenue-generating relationships across the business and work directly with the CEO to drive growth.



The Opportunity



This is not a traditional sales role. We are looking for a proven closer who can build opportunities from scratch, develop relationships with decision-makers, and personally close deals.



You will own the full sales cycle across multiple business lines and play a key role in helping scale the company internationally. This role begins as a part-time position at 20 hours per week. Candidates who demonstrate strong execution, ownership, and the ability to consistently generate and close opportunities will have the opportunity to transition into a full-time role at 40 hours per week.



We believe in rewarding results. As you help grow the business, the role will grow alongside you.



What You'll Be Responsible For



You will own all revenue-generating relationships across the group, including brand partnerships, media licensing opportunities, FAST and OTT distribution partnerships, DubDash new business development, and creator service partnerships.



You will be responsible for building and managing your own pipeline, conducting outbound prospecting, qualifying opportunities, leading discovery and sales calls, creating proposals, negotiating commercial terms, closing deals, and ensuring a smooth handoff to operations. You will also maintain CRM accuracy, provide regular reporting, forecast revenue, and proactively identify risks and opportunities.



This position reports directly to the CEO with a dotted reporting line to the COO.



What We're Looking For



We are seeking someone with at least four years of B2B sales or business development experience and a demonstrated personal track record of closing consultative, multi-week sales opportunities. You should be able to show real numbers and revenue results from deals you have personally closed.



You must be comfortable owning the full sales cycle from prospecting to close and be confident communicating with senior decision-makers across Europe, the United States, and the Middle East. Near-native business English, both written and verbal, is essential for this role.



The ideal candidate is highly organized, self-motivated, accountable, and capable of building systems and opportunities from scratch. We are looking for a self-starter who can operate independently while maintaining strong communication with leadership.



Candidates with experience in SaaS, media, creator economy businesses, content licensing, FAST channels, OTT distribution, or high-ticket B2B services will be viewed favorably, although these are not required.



This Role Is Not For You If



Your recent career has focused primarily on managing sales teams instead of personally closing deals. You have experience only in appointment setting or SDR roles without a proven closing record. You rely on company logos or network connections rather than demonstrated sales performance. You require a fully built-out system, extensive support, or a large team in order to succeed.



Why Join JVDB Studios



This is a unique opportunity to work directly with a founder who has built audiences of more than 15 million subscribers and multiple successful digital businesses. You will have direct access to leadership, exposure to international clients and partnerships, and the opportunity to play a key role in shaping the commercial future of a rapidly growing media company.



You will work in a fully remote environment with a Monday-to-Friday schedule and collaborate with partners and clients across Europe, North America, and the Middle East. The role offers uncapped commission potential and a clear path from a part-time position into a full-time opportunity for individuals who consistently deliver results.



How to Apply



Subject Line: JVDB Sales Manager



Send your updated resume along with a short Loom video introducing yourself and discussing your sales experience. In your video, please share examples of deals you have personally closed, the types of clients you have worked with, and any sales metrics or achievements you are proud of.



Please send your application to:







Only candidates with a proven track record of personally closing deals will be considered.

We are seeking a highly organized and process-driven Service Desk Manager to lead the day-to-day operations of our Managed Services Provider (MSP) service desk. This role is responsible for overseeing ticket flow from intake through resolution, ensuring efficient workload distribution, SLA adherence, and a consistent, high-quality customer experience.



The ideal candidate excels in workflow management, team coordination, and continuous process improvement. Deep technical expertise is not required; success in this role is driven by strong operational discipline and leadership.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Service Desk Operations

- Own and manage the full lifecycle of all service desk tickets—from creation to closure

- Monitor ticket queues to ensure timely response and resolution in line with SLAs

- Identify and remove workflow bottlenecks to maintain consistent throughput

- Ensure accurate ticket categorization, prioritization, and documentation



Ticket Management & Resource Coordination

- Assign tickets to appropriate technicians based on workload, skill alignment, and urgency

- Balance workload across the team to maximize efficiency and prevent burnout

- Continuously track ticket progress and follow up to drive timely completion

- Escalate issues appropriately when risks to SLAs or customer satisfaction arise



Process Management & Improvement

- Develop, implement, and enforce standardized service desk processes and workflows

- Analyze ticket trends, recurring issues, and inefficiencies to recommend improvements

- Drive adoption of best practices for ticket handling, communication, and documentation

- Maintain and optimize internal knowledge base and operational playbooks



Team Leadership & Accountability

-Provide day-to-day oversight of service desk technicians

- Set expectations for performance, ticket handling, and customer communication

- Conduct regular check-ins to ensure alignment and address operational challenges

- Foster a culture of accountability, efficiency, and continuous improvement



Performance Monitoring & Reporting

- Track and report on key metrics (SLA compliance, ticket volume, resolution time, backlog)

- Use data to identify performance gaps and improvement opportunities

- Provide regular operational updates to leadership



Client Experience

- Ensure consistent, professional communication with customers throughout ticket lifecycle

- Address escalated concerns and ensure positive outcomes

- Maintain high customer satisfaction through reliable and predictable service delivery



QUALIFICATIONS

title: META CREATIVE STRATEGIST & VIDEO EDITOR
description:
Forge & Foundry | Full-Time | Remote | $4.00 – $7.50 USD/hour



?????????????????????????????????????????????????????????



ABOUT THE ROLE



We're looking for a talented, driven Meta Creative Strategist and Video Editor to join Forge & Foundry full-time and remotely from the Philippines.



This is not a junior support role. You will own our creative pipeline end-to-end — identifying winning angles, briefing creators, editing video ads, and managing our UGC pipeline. You'll work directly with the founders and see the direct impact of your work on ad performance and business results.



We currently spend $10,000/month on Meta advertising and are scaling fast. To get there, we need dramatically more creative output. We need 80–120+ assets per month. You'll be the engine that makes that happen.



?????????????????????????????????????????????????????????



ABOUT FORGE & FOUNDRY



Forge & Foundry is a London-based men's personalised jewellery brand. We sell engraved bracelets, titanium cuffs, signet rings, and accessories across our Shopify store, Amazon UK and US, and Not On The High Street.



We design in London, ship worldwide, and are building one of the strongest DTC brands in personalised men's jewellery. We're a commercially sharp, fast-moving team that invests in the people helping us grow.



?????????????????????????????????????????????????????????



WHAT YOU'LL DO



CREATIVE STRATEGY

- Analyse weekly ad performance to identify what's working and why — angle, hook, format, offer, emotion

- Research new creative angles using Meta Ad Library, TikTok, Reddit, Amazon reviews, and competitor analysis

- Develop and maintain a 4–6 week creative testing pipeline — always ahead, never reactive

- Write sharp, platform-native hooks, body copy, and CTAs that drive clicks and conversions

- Brief our AI visual creator on static asset needs with clear creative direction



VIDEO EDITING & PRODUCTION

- Edit UGC footage, product clips, and raw content into finished Meta ads (15–60 seconds)

- Produce hook variants of winning ads — same body, 5 different opening 3 seconds

- Build a template library for fast-turnaround formats: testimonial, price reveal, feature callout, unboxing, ASMR

- Format all assets correctly for Meta placements (9:16, 4:5, 1:1 — safe zones, captions, aspect ratios)

- Target turnaround of 2–4 hours per finished ad edit from raw footage



UGC CREATOR MANAGEMENT

- Manage our UGC pipeline via Influee — outreach, briefing, follow-up, quality control

- Build and maintain a roster of 8–12 active micro-creators shooting content monthly

- Write specific, emotionally-driven creator briefs (not "wear the bracelet" — "film your partner's reaction when they open the package and read the engraving for the first time")

- Coordinate gifting and logistics; ensure creators deliver on brief and on time



YOUR WEEKLY RHYTHM

- Monday: Review last week's performance. Plan the week's creative output. Identify new angles.

- Tuesday–Thursday: Video editing, hook variants, asset production

- Friday: UGC outreach, creator follow-up, brief planning for the following week

- Daily (30 min): Monitor Meta Ad Library and TikTok for creative trends



?????????????????????????????????????????????????????????



WEEKLY OUTPUT TARGETS



You'll be held to clear, measurable output from week one:



- Finished video ads (edited, hook-first, caption-ready): 5–8 per week

- Hook variants of existing winning ads: 3–5 per week

- UGC creator briefs sent or followed up: 5–10 per week

- New creative angles researched and logged: 3–5 per week

- New creator briefs written: 2–3 per week



?????????????????????????????????????????????????????????



WHO YOU ARE



NON-NEGOTIABLES



- You have a portfolio of Meta and/or TikTok ad edits for DTC product brands. Specifically ads — not general content, not brand films, not lifestyle reels. Ads.

- You can articulate why an ad works. Hook structure, pacing, emotional trigger, retention curve — you think in these terms naturally.

- You're fast. A finished, caption-ready Meta ad edit takes you 2–4 hours from raw footage, not 2 days.

- You're fluent with AI tools — Midjourney, Kling, Runway, Pika, or equivalents — for concept generation and AI video.

- Your written English is strong. Your hooks and copy must be sharp and native-sounding.

- You're self-directed. You don't wait to be told what to make next — you bring ideas, flag opportunities, and drive output independently.



STRONG ADVANTAGES

- Experience with jewellery, fashion, accessories, or gifting brands

- You've managed UGC creator outreach and pipelines before

- You understand Meta performance metrics — CTR, hook rate, thumb-stop ratio, ROAS

- You've worked in-house at a DTC brand, not just agency-side — you have brand ownership mentality

- Experience with Influee, Billo, or similar UGC platforms



PLEASE DON'T APPLY IF...

- Your portfolio is mostly long-form content, brand films, or cinematic reels — the pacing is wrong for Meta ads

- You can't explain specifically why a particular ad in your portfolio worked

- You're a slow communicator — responsiveness during UK overlap hours is non-negotiable

- You're looking for a quiet, steady role — this is a high-output, high-energy position



?????????????????????????????????????????????????????????



TOOLS



- Video editing: CapCut, Premiere Pro, or equivalent (fast, ad-native workflow)

- AI image/video: Midjourney, Kling, Runway, Pika — any combination

- UGC: Influee (we'll train you if needed)

- Creative research: Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center

- Project management: Notion or Trello

- Communication: Slack (responsive during UK overlap hours required)



?????????????????????????????????????????????????????????



ROLE DETAILS



- Type: Full-time, remote

- Location: Philippines-based

- Rate: $4.50 – $7.50 USD/hour, depending on experience. Reviewed at 3 months.

- Hours: 40 hours per week, UK-aligned overlap required — approx. 12:00–20:00 Philippine Time

- Reports to: Co-Founder / Head of Growth

- Start date: ASAP — ideally within 4 weeks



?????????????????????????????????????????????????????????



WHAT WE OFFER



- $4.50 – $7.50 USD/hour, reviews based on output and quality

- Full creative ownership — your work will be live in front of tens of thousands of people

- Direct access to founders — no layers, no bureaucracy, fast decisions

- A brand that's growing fast and genuinely invests in the people helping it grow

- Bonus structure based on KPIs



GETTING STARTED



This role includes a 3-month probationary period. We'll assess output, communication, and fit — and you'll have the same opportunity to assess us. Rate and responsibilities are reviewed at the end of month 3.



New hires start at [20 hrs/week OR full-time] for the first 30 days while getting up to speed on the brand and creative standards. [Hours scale to 40/week from day 31 / Full output targets apply from week 5.]



?????????????????????????????????????????????????????????



HOW TO APPLY



Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.



Please send us the following:



1. Your portfolio — links to Meta or TikTok ads you have edited for DTC product brands. Dropbox, Google Drive, or direct links are all fine.



2. Answer this question in 2–3 sentences: Pick one ad from your portfolio and tell us why it worked. What hook did it use, what emotion did it target, and what would you test next?



3. A brief note on your experience with UGC creator management and AI creative tools.



4. Your availability and earliest start date.



We review applications on a rolling basis and move quickly.



?????????????????????????????????????????????????????????

description:
Operations Manager (Virtual Assistant)



Paradise Auto Care | Remote | Full-Time | US Pacific Time Hours





WHAT THIS IS



Paradise Auto Care is a premium mobile detailing and vehicle protection studio based in Lake Elsinore, California. We serve high-value clients across the Temecula Valley who trust us with some of their most prized possessions.



This is not a task list job.



This is a role for someone who will become the operational backbone of a growing business — managing client communications, running our CRM, building our systems in Notion, posting content daily across multiple social media platforms, and editing short-form video content for two brands.



If you want easy work, this is not it.

If you want ownership, growth, and a business that invests in people who perform — keep reading.





ROLE SUMMARY



The Operations & Client Experience Manager is a full-ownership remote role responsible for running the back end of Paradise Auto Care and supporting the CEO Paradise personal brand.



This is not a support role. This is an execution role.



You will respond to leads, manage our CRM pipeline, own our Notion workspace, post daily to all social media platforms, and edit short-form video content using CapCut — across two brands.



While the owner focuses on sales and service delivery, you make sure everything else runs.





SCHEDULE & PAY





Hours: 6 hours/day | 5 days/week | 30 hours/week

Starting pay: $30/day

Pay schedule: Weekly via Wise

Hours: Must be available during US Pacific Time business hours

Raises: 30 / 60 / 90-day performance milestones — clearly defined

Bonuses: Available for complex projects and skill growth

Growth: Editing skill development leads to direct pay increases







CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



Lead Response & Call Setting — Priority #1





-Respond to every new inbound lead within 5 minutes — no exceptions

-Follow our Call Setter SOP — book a sales call with Mike, do not give pricing

-Manage the full CRM pipeline in GoHighLevel / LeadFuse daily

-Run follow-up sequences for every non-responsive lead through all pipeline stages

-Handle Instagram DMs,
 messages, and all inbound inquiries

-Confirm and remind clients of all scheduled appointments





Scheduling & Calendar Management





-Fully manage the owner's Urable calendar

-Offer two accurate time windows per booking — always cross-check calendar first

-Handle reschedules, cancellations, and day-of confirmations





CRM & Tool Mastery





-Keep GoHighLevel / LeadFuse pipeline clean, tagged, and moving daily

-Audit and build GHL automations and workflows

-Watch all Urable tutorial videos — find and implement unused features

-Report weekly on tool improvements made and features discovered





Notion — Company Operating System





-Build our entire Notion workspace from scratch in collaboration with the owner

-Import and format all existing SOPs into Notion

-Build technician checklists, content calendars, KPI dashboards, and hiring pipelines

-Document every process learned as a clean, usable SOP

-Maintain and update SOPs as the business evolves





Google Business Profile





-Post 4–5+ times per week following our SEO SOP

-Rename all photo files using our SEO naming formula before uploading

-Pull monthly GBP performance report





Social Media — Paradise Auto Care





-Post daily Stories to Instagram and

-Post Reels, TikToks, and YouTube Shorts 4–5x per week

-Respond to comments and non-sales DMs daily

-Maintain and execute the PAC content calendar in Notion





Social Media — CEO Paradise (Personal Brand)



-Post Reels, TikToks, and YouTube Shorts 3–5x per week

-Maintain and execute the CEO Paradise content calendar in Notion — separate identity, separate voice





Video Editing — CapCut





-Edit raw job footage into short-form Reels, TikToks, and YouTube Shorts

-Add captions, text overlays, music, and transitions per brand guidelines

-Format and export correctly for each platform

-Edit technician talking-head videos and owner lifestyle/business content

-Build a simple video style guide for both brands in first 30 days

-Organize all finished content in Drive/Notion by brand and platform





Content Footage Pipeline





-Monitor shared Drive folder daily for new footage uploads from technicians

-Organize raw footage into Notion content library by brand, type, and status

-Move content through pipeline stages: raw ? editing ? ready to post ? posted

-Flag best footage to owner for approval before editing begins




 & General Admin





-Manage owner's
 inbox — filter, flag, organize, draft responses

-Handle vendor communication and follow-ups

-Research tasks as assigned

-Post-job review request and referral ask texts within 24 hours of every completed job







NON-NEGOTIABLE STANDARDS





Respond to new leads within 5 minutes during business hours — always

Be fully present and reachable during your 6-hour shift

Document every process you learn — if it isn't written, it doesn't exist

Never give pricing to leads — that is Mike's job on the call

Maintain two separate brand voices — PAC and CEO Paradise are not the same

Cross-check Urable before offering any time window to a lead

Deliver edits that are clean, on-brand, and ready to post — not drafts







THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR SOMEONE WHO:





Has never used a CRM and is not hungry to learn one fast

Has never used Notion or cannot build a workspace from scratch

Cannot operate CapCut at a basic to intermediate level

Needs to be told what to do every hour

Is slow to respond during work hours

Is managing multiple clients — we need full focus, full time

Uses passive language — "I try to," "I usually," "I think I can"

Has rated themselves five stars in every skill category on their profile

Has no ID or verification uploaded on their Onlinejobs.ph profile

Is looking for easy, low-responsibility remote work

Has no clear personal goals — urgency without goals is not sustainable







WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR





At least 2 years of VA, operations, or online business management experience

Proven Notion experience — you must be able to show us a workspace you built

CRM experience — you understand pipelines, stages, tags, and follow-up sequences

CapCut experience — you can edit a clean Reel with captions, music, and overlays

Professional, clear, warm English — clients and leads will be talking to you

Social media management experience across Instagram, TikTok,
, YouTube Shorts

Systems thinker — you build the process, not just complete the task

Available and responsive during US Pacific Time hours

Someone with goals, drive, and a reason to perform at a high level







TOOLS YOU WILL USE





GoHighLevel — CRM (training provided — must learn fast)

Urable — Scheduling and job management (training provided — must go deep)

Notion — Operations hub (must already know — you will build this)

CapCut — Video editing (must already know — show us samples)

Google Workspace — Drive, Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Google Business Profile

Mailchimp —
 marketing

Instagram, TikTok,
, YouTube — Both brands

Loom — Daily async communication with owner

Wise — Weekly payment

Slack — Communication & Team Updates







THE 40-DAY ONBOARDING WINDOW



Our current admin assistant is transitioning out in 40 days.



You will be trained alongside her before she leaves — learning the call setter role, the CRM pipeline, our systems, our voice, and our standards directly from her and the owner.



This means you must be hired and actively onboarding within the next 2-3 weeks.



After 40 days — this is entirely yours.



We are not filling a seat. We are handing over a role to someone who will own it, improve it, and make it better than it has ever been.



HOW TO APPLY —  4-STEP INSTRUCTIONS



To be considered you must complete all 4 steps below. Missing any step means your application will not be reviewed — no exceptions.



STEP 1 — Apply through this listing



Submit your application on Onlinejobs.ph.



STEP 2 — Answer all 4 questions in your cover message

Copy and paste these questions and answer each one directly:



1. What CRM have you used and what specifically did you manage inside it?

2. Describe a Notion workspace you have built for a business — what did it include and what is the most advanced feature you used?

3. Tell us about a time you identified something broken or inefficient and fixed it without being asked.

4. A new lead texts in at 9:04 AM. It is now 9:11 AM and you have not replied. What do you do and why does those 7 minutes matter?





STEP 3 — Record a Loom video (90 seconds max) and include the link

Go to 
 and record a video that shows ALL of the following:

You must appear on camera the entire time — face visible, not just your screen.



Your video must include:



Your face on camera introducing yourself — your name, where you are in the Philippines, and how long you have been a VA

A screen share of a Notion workspace you personally built — walk us through it for 30–45 seconds. Show us the databases, the structure, and how you organized it. If you have never built a Notion workspace for a business, do not apply.

10–15 seconds of a CapCut video you edited — show us a finished short-form video you made with captions, music, and text overlays



If your Loom does not show your face — it will not be reviewed.



No Loom link = automatic disqualification.



STEP 4 — Include your Loom link in your cover message

Paste your Loom link directly in your cover message alongside your 4 question answers. Applications without the Loom link will not be opened.



No Loom = no interview. No exceptions.





WHAT HAPPENS NEXT





- We review every application personally

- Top candidates receive a paid 2-hour skills test ($10 via Wise)

- Finalists interview via video call with the owner- The right person starts within 1–2 weeks





We move fast. If you are the right person, you will know quickly.





We would rather stay understaffed than lower our standards.



Paradise Auto Care | Lake Elsinore, CA | 

Detailing with Purpose & Passion

title: Junior Talent Coordinator

You'll support the full hiring lifecycle — from posting jobs and screening applicants to scheduling interviews and keeping our recruitment process running smoothly every single day.



This isn't a coffee-fetching, task-logging kind of role. From day one, you'll be doing real, meaningful work that directly shapes who joins our team — and ultimately, who we become as a company.

If you're someone who is organized, genuinely people-driven, and hungry to grow a career in HR and talent acquisition, we would love to build that future with you.

s and messages make people feel seen and respected

title: Virtual Assistant / Office Admin – Restoration & Construction Company
description:
Job Description:



We are a fast-growing SERVPRO restoration company based in Orange County, California. We are looking for a long-term Virtual Assistant / Office Admin in the Philippines to help with job file coordination, CRM updates, documentation, scheduling, customer communication, and administrative support.



This is not a basic data entry role. We need someone who is organized, detail-oriented, tech-savvy, and able to learn new systems quickly. Our company works with insurance claims, water damage, fire damage, mold remediation, construction, and restoration jobs, so accuracy and documentation are very important.



This is a long-term opportunity with room to grow and potential bonus incentives based on performance.



Schedule:



Full-time preferred

Monday–Friday

Pacific Time business hours preferred

Must be available for regular communication during California business hours



Main Responsibilities:



Manage and update job files in our CRM systems

Upload and organize photos, notes, documents, invoices, and job information

Review job files for missing information or documentation issues

Assist with insurance documentation and file compliance

Monitor job progress, task lists, WIP updates, and audit status

Coordinate with office staff, project managers, technicians, and customers

Help schedule inspections, jobs, subcontractors, and follow-ups

Handle
 communication and basic customer communication

Perform data entry in CRM, Google Sheets, QuickBooks Online, and other systems

Assist with reporting, file review, and administrative tasks

Follow SOPs and help improve systems as the role grows



Required Skills:



Strong computer skills and ability to learn new software quickly

Strong Google Workspace skills: Gmail, Google Drive, Google Sheets, Google Docs, and Google Calendar

Excellent written English communication

Organized and detail-oriented

Able to follow instructions carefully

Able to work independently and ask good questions when needed

Comfortable working with multiple software systems

Reliable, honest, and looking for a long-term position

Fast learner with strong problem-solving ability

Able to work in a fast-paced environment with many active jobs at once



Preferred Experience:



Experience with restoration, construction, insurance, property claims, or service-based businesses

Experience with Xactimate is highly preferred

Experience with DASH, Solitaire, WorkCenter, NextGear, or other CRM software is preferred

Experience with QuickBooks Online is preferred

Experience reviewing job files, estimates, invoices, or insurance documentation is a plus

Experience supporting a U.S.-based company is a plus



Technical Requirements:



Windows 10 or Windows 11 computer required

Intel i5 / Ryzen 5 or better preferred

16 GB RAM preferred; 8 GB RAM minimum

SSD storage preferred

Reliable internet required: minimum 50 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload

Backup internet required, such as mobile hotspot or secondary connection

Webcam and noise-canceling headset required

Quiet work environment required

Must be comfortable with video calls, screen sharing, and cloud-based software

Must be able to provide a screenshot of computer specs and internet speed test during the application process



What Success Looks Like:



You stay organized even when multiple jobs are active

You catch missing information before it becomes a problem

You communicate clearly and professionally

You follow through without needing constant reminders

You learn our process and improve over time

You take ownership of your work

You are dependable, responsive, and accurate



How to Apply:



Please reply with the subject line: SERVPRO Admin VA



In your application, please answer the following:



What admin, CRM, construction, restoration, insurance, or bookkeeping experience do you have?

What software have you used before? Please include Google Workspace, QuickBooks, Xactimate, DASH, Solitaire, or any CRM experience.

Are you comfortable working California business hours?

What are your computer specs?

What is your internet speed?

Do you have backup internet?

Why are you interested in a long-term role with our company?



Please also include a short paragraph explaining why you would be a strong fit for this role.

title: Creative Strategist (Meta Ads & Content)
description:

Prayer Scarves is a Christian brand creating scripture-inspired scarves designed to encourage intimacy with God through His Word. Our products are often purchased as meaningful gifts that uplift, encourage, and equip women in specific seasons of life.



We are looking for a Creative Strategist who can help us identify, develop, and test concepts for Meta ads and social content.



This is not primarily a video editing role.



The most important part of this role is the ability to recognize opportunities, identify strong hooks, mine existing content, and generate creative concepts that connect with women of faith.





RESPONSIBILITIES:

Creative Strategy

Identify hooks, angles, and creative concepts for Meta ads

Study existing content and uncover opportunities for new ads

Recommend new content as needed

Generate multiple testable variations of winning creatives

Suggest improvements to existing ads and creatives

Research trends, patterns, and creative approaches that can be adapted authentically to our audience

Creative Development

Write headlines and primary text variations

Create ad concepts and creative briefs

Recommend specific content to capture

Identify content gaps and opportunities

Asset Creation (Preferred) (Static image ads, carousel ads, short-form video ads)



Strong execution skills are a plus, but strategic thinking is the priority.





Success in this role is measured by your ability to:



Find opportunities hidden in existing content

Generate fresh ideas consistently

Create enough quality creative to test regularly

Learn from performance and improve future concepts

Reduce the founder's creative workload





IDEAL CANDIDATE:

Naturally notice strong hooks and messaging

Enjoy studying ads and content that perform well

Think creatively and strategically

Understand emotional buying decisions

Can recognize what makes people stop scrolling

Are comfortable working with Christian and Scripture-centered content

Respect the difference between ministry-focused encouragement and hype-driven marketing





NICE TO HAVE:

Experience creating Meta ad creatives

UGC creative strategy experience

Canva, CapCut, Premiere, or similar tools

Experience working with DTC or e-commerce brands

Familiarity with testing multiple creative variations



---------------------------------------------------------------------------------



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



Please provide:



Portfolio or examples of work

Your hourly rate

Your availability

Prayer Scarves customers are often buying for someone else.

title: Shopify Implementation Specialist
description:
Tomorrow Studios is a Shopify design and implementation studio based in British Columbia, Canada. We help merchants move to Shopify, clean up their product data, configure apps and systems, and launch stores that are easy to manage. Our projects include migrations from BigCommerce, WooCommerce, and Lightspeed; Shopify store setup; Shopify POS and B2B configuration; app configuration; catalogue cleanup; QA; and ongoing client support.



We're a small, fast-moving team. We care a lot about clear communication, attention to detail, and reliability. We're looking for someone dependable who can take ownership of implementation tasks from start to finish and grow with us long-term.



About the role



This is not mainly a theme/coding role. The main focus is Shopify implementation: data migration, store configuration, app setup, QA, and day-to-day support. You'll organize product, customer, and order data; configure Shopify settings and apps; test store functionality; document your work; and help with client launches.



You should be comfortable with spreadsheets, Shopify admin, migration tools, and checklists. You don't need to be a senior developer, but you should be organized, detail-oriented, and able to solve problems on your own.



Your responsibilities





Prepare, clean, and organize ecommerce data for Shopify migrations

Use tools such as Matrixify to import and export products, customers, orders, redirects, and metafields

Support migrations from BigCommerce, WooCommerce, Lightspeed, and CSV files

Configure Shopify settings: products, collections, markets, shipping, taxes, payments, locations, staff permissions, and sales channels

Set up and configure Shopify apps based on project needs

Work with metafields, metaobjects, tags, product options, and redirects

Support Shopify POS and B2B configuration when needed

Do QA before and after launch (product, checkout, app, redirect, mobile, and content checks)

Document your completed work, open issues, and client instructions

Communicate clearly with the team and, when needed, with clients

Flag technical issues that need custom development





Nice to have (not required)





Basic Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript

Familiarity with the Shopify theme editor and Online Store 2.0

Experience with Shopify Plus, POS, or B2B

Experience with BigCommerce or WooCommerce

Experience with ERP, accounting, inventory, reviews, subscriptions, loyalty, or
 marketing apps

SEO migration basics (redirects and metadata)

Experience working with an agency or multiple clients





Who we're looking for





Very strong attention to detail

Comfortable with spreadsheets and structured data

Clear written English

Reliable follow-through and clear documentation

Comfortable asking questions when something is unclear

Able to work independently after getting direction

Willing to learn new Shopify apps and workflows





Details: Full-time, long-term, work from home. Approximately 30–40 hours/week with meaningful daily overlap with Pacific Time (we'll confirm hours together).





Before you apply (please read carefully):



We read every application, and we want people who actually read the whole job post. To show us you did:





Begin your application by telling us your favorite animal. Applications that don't start with an animal will be skipped.

In 2–3 sentences, explain how you would migrate a product catalogue from BigCommerce to Shopify — including which tool you'd use to import the data and one thing you'd check before the store goes live.





We look forward to your answer.

title: ESL Teacher / Tutor (Bisaya/Cebuano Speaking) – Help a Recent High School Graduate Achieve Professional English Fluency
description:

Position:

Compensation:

$4.00 – $6.00 USD per hour** (based on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated ability)



Schedule:

* 3-4 Days Per Week

* 1 Hour Per Session

* Long-Term Opportunity

* Flexible Scheduling (to be coordinated with the student)



---



About the Opportunity:



OneSpot is seeking an experienced, patient, and engaging ESL Teacher / Tutor to work one-on-one with a recent high school graduate whose native language is Bisaya/Cebuano.



The student is highly motivated and is looking to improve their English skills for professional and workplace communication. The ultimate goal is to develop confidence in speaking, understanding, reading, and writing English at a professional level and eventually achieve conversational fluency.



We are looking for a teacher who can effectively bridge the gap between Cebuano and English while providing a structured, proven learning experience.



This role may expand to more hours depending upon student's progress.



---



Student Profile



The Student:

* Is a recent high school graduate

* Is a native Bisaya/Cebuano speaker

* Has limited English comprehension and conversational ability

* Wants to improve English for employment opportunities

* Wants to become confident communicating professionally in English

* Is seeking long-term improvement and fluency



---



Responsibilities



The selected teacher will:

* Conduct live one-on-one online tutoring sessions

* Create an encouraging and supportive learning environment

* Teach practical American conversational English

* Teach professional workplace communication skills

* Improve listening comprehension

* Improve pronunciation and speaking confidence

* Teach grammar in a practical, easy-to-understand manner

* Help develop professional vocabulary

* Assign simple homework and practice exercises

* Track student progress and provide periodic feedback

* Adjust teaching methods based on the student's learning pace

* Encourage consistent English usage during sessions



---



Required Qualifications



Applicants MUST meet ALL of the following requirements:



Experience:

* Minimum of **4 years of ESL teaching or tutoring experience**

* Experience teaching beginner or low-intermediate English learners

* Experience teaching teenagers and/or young adults preferred



Education:

* College Degree required

* Education, English, Communication, Linguistics, or related degrees are preferred but not required



Language Requirements:

* Must be fluent in English

* Must be able to speak Bisaya/Cebuano fluently

* Must be comfortable explaining English concepts in Cebuano when necessary



Teaching System



Applicants MUST already have:

* A structured ESL curriculum

* A proven teaching methodology

* Lesson plans already developed

* Learning materials already available

* A clear progression system for beginner students



We are NOT seeking someone who intends to create lessons from scratch each week. We prefer a teacher who already has a tested program and can begin immediately.



---



Preferred Qualifications



Strong preference will be given to candidates who have:

* TEFL Certification

* TESOL Certification

* CELTA Certification

* Experience teaching professional/business English

* Experience preparing students for employment opportunities

* Experience teaching American English pronunciation and conversational skills

* Experience conducting lessons via Zoom or Google Meet



---



Technical Requirements



Applicants must have:

* Reliable high-speed internet connection

* Functional webcam

* Clear microphone/audio quality

* Quiet teaching environment

* Ability to conduct video-based lessons without interruption



---



What Success Looks Like



Within the first several months, we expect the student to:

* Build confidence speaking English

* Understand common workplace conversations

* Introduce themselves professionally

* Communicate effectively during interviews

* Write basic professional messages and
s

* Improve listening comprehension

* Develop stronger English vocabulary



Long-term success will be measured by the student's ability to communicate professionally and confidently in English.



---



Application Instructions (IMPORTANT)



To be considered, applicants MUST submit:



1. Resume



Please include:

* ESL teaching experience

* Education history

* Certifications

* Relevant tutoring experience



2. Curriculum Information



Please briefly explain:

* Your teaching methodology

* Your curriculum structure

* Your lesson progression

* Materials and resources you use



3. Customized Video Introduction (Required)



Please record a short video (2–5 minutes) introducing yourself.



In your video, please tell us:

* Who you are

* Your ESL teaching background

* Your experience teaching beginner English learners

* Why you believe you are an excellent fit for this student

* How you would help a Cebuano-speaking student become professionally fluent in English



Important: Please do NOT read from a script.



We want to see your natural communication style, personality, and teaching presence. Simply speak openly and from the heart as if you were talking directly to the student.



Applications submitted without a customized video may not be considered.



---



Additional Notes



We are looking for someone who is:

* Patient

* Positive

* Professional

* Dependable

* Passionate about teaching

* Committed to helping students succeed



This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced ESL educator who already has a proven system and enjoys helping motivated students reach real-world English fluency.



We look forward to meeting you.

title: History YouTube Video Editor Needed (Long-Term Opportunity)
description:
I’m looking for a reliable and creative video editor for a growing faceless history YouTube channel.



The goal is simple: create engaging, high-quality history videos using strong visuals, clean storytelling, and animations that add to the content rather than distract from it.



The aesthetic I’m looking for is polished, professional, and thoughtfully crafted. This is not a “throw stock footage everywhere” type of channel, and I’m not interested in low-effort, template-driven edits. I want someone who takes pride in their work and wants to help build something long term.



The overall pacing should be cinematic and immersive rather than fast, flashy, or overloaded with effects. I will provide a reference video so you can understand the exact editing style I’m looking for.



What I’m Looking For



* High-quality animations that help explain historical events, battles, timelines, and concepts

* Motion graphics, maps, diagrams, and visual storytelling

* Cinematic movement on historical images, paintings, and photographs

* Smooth transitions and professional pacing

* Strong attention to detail and synchronization with voiceovers

* Appropriate background music and sound design that enhance the story (I have an Artlist subscription available if needed)

* Ability to source relevant public-domain footage, historical imagery, and supporting visuals when necessary



Examples of Skills That Stand Out



* Animated maps and troop movements

* Timeline animations

* Historical document and photograph animations

* Motion graphics that explain complex events clearly

* Clean typography and on-screen graphics

* Creative use of archival footage and public-domain material

* Documentary-style storytelling



Pay & Workflow



* Starting Pay: $65 USD per project

* Video Length: Typically 10–20 minutes

* Frequency: 1–2 videos per week

* Scripts, voiceovers, research, and creative direction are provided



Long-Term Opportunity



I am looking for a long-term editor, not a one-off freelancer.



Editors who consistently produce high-quality work, communicate well, and prove reliable will receive higher rates over time. My goal is to build a lasting working relationship and increase compensation as the channel grows.



The starting rate is $65 per project, but my goal is to move the right editor to $100+ per project as the channel becomes successful and we establish trust.



What I Provide



* Complete voiceover

* Complete script

* Research and source material

* Creative direction when needed

* Reference videos for editing style



How to Apply



1. Send a link to your portfolio or previous work.

2. Tell me what software you use (DaVinci Resolve preferred) and briefly describe the types of animations or motion graphics you create.

3. Start your application with the word “EDITOR” so I know you read the entire post.

4. Briefly describe any experience you have with YouTube content, history content, or documentary-style editing.



Note: Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a brief paid 60-second trial project.

title: Ecommerce - Customer Service Representative
description:
You'll be the human our customers actually want to reach.



Most supplement companies treat support as a cost to minimize — hidden behind apps with no cancel button, no phone number, and no reply for days. We're building the opposite. In a category full of subscription traps and ghost-town inboxes, responsive, honest, genuinely caring support is our competitive advantage. You'll be the person who makes that real.

Our customers are mostly people managing their cholesterol — many of them older, many navigating decisions about statins and their health. When they write in, they're often anxious, confused about dosage, or worried about a charge they didn't expect. How you respond shapes whether they trust us. That's not a small job. It's one of the most important ones we have.





What you'll actually do:



Be the fast, friendly reply customers rarely get elsewhere — handling questions about orders, billing, subscriptions, refunds, and shipping with genuine care.



Handle sensitive health questions responsibly — answering dosage and product questions from approved information, and always pointing customers to their doctor on anything medical. You'll never improvise on health advice.



Turn frustrated customers into loyal ones. A well-handled refund or a patient explanation often earns more trust than a perfect order ever could.



Be the voice of the customer internally — flagging the recurring confusion and friction you see so we fix problems at the source, not one ticket at a time.



You'll thrive here if you...



? Write like a warm, clear human — not a script or a robot

? Stay calm and kind when someone's upset, and don't take it personally

? Take real ownership: you'd rather solve it now than pass it along

? Have an instinct for empathy, especially with older or worried customers

? Are organized enough to keep dozens of conversations moving without dropping anyone

? Care about doing the right thing even when no one's watching



This probably isn't for you if you want a role where you copy-paste canned replies and clock out, or where "policy" is an excuse not to help. We're looking for someone who takes pride in actually fixing things.



Why this role is different:



Your work matters and it shows. You'll see the reviews change, the chargebacks drop, the "thank you for actually responding"
s come in.



I'm looking forward to hearing from you, and I hope to have you become a part of our team!

title: AI Content Creation VA (Short-Form Video)
description:
Hiring: AI Content Creation VA (Short-Form Video)

We are a social media content company that creates short-form video content for health and wellness brands on Instagram. We use AI tools to generate images, voiceovers, talking head videos, and motion clips, then edit everything together into finished Instagram Reels. This is a long-term position, not a one-time project.

What you will be doing:

Using AI tools to generate realistic images of characters (Nano Banana Pro)

Generating natural sounding voiceovers (ElevenLabs)

Creating talking head videos (HeyGen)

Generating motion video clips (Google Veo 3)

Editing everything together into polished short-form videos (CapCut or your preferred editing software)

Using Claude AI to write prompts and improve your work quality

You do not need prior experience with these specific tools. We have a full 9-stage onboarding program that trains you on everything step by step. But you do need to be someone who learns fast and pays attention to detail.

What we are looking for:

Reliable and consistent. You show up every day and communicate if something comes up. This is the number one thing we care about.

Detail-oriented. The difference between a good video and a bad one comes down to small details.

Coachable. You take feedback seriously and apply it to your next video.

Has their own laptop or desktop computer with a stable internet connection.

Has their own video editing software (CapCut works great).

Can follow instructions carefully without needing to be told the same thing twice.

Schedule: Monday through Saturday. Daily check-in at 9:00 AM PHT. All work for the day must be completed and submitted by 9:00 PM PHT.

Pay: $4–6 per finished video, depending on quality and complexity. At 3–4 videos per day, six days a week, that comes out to roughly $400–600 per month. Strong performers also earn view-based bonuses on top of their per-video pay.

Onboarding: Once you're brought onto the team, you'll go through our 9-stage onboarding program that trains you on every tool step by step. We move through it quickly so you're producing at a high level fast. Because of that pace, we're looking for people who can put focused time in during their first week.

To apply: Do not just send me a message saying you are interested. To be considered for this position you must complete the following test assignment and include it in your application: 

Applications without the completed assignment will not be reviewed. This is how we filter for people who actually pay attention and follow instructions. If you have any questions about the role, include them in your message along with your completed assignment.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

title: Service Desk Manager, Client Experience (MSP)
description:
Job Title: Service Desk Manager (MSP)



We are seeking a highly organized and process-driven Service Desk Manager to lead the day-to-day operations of our Managed Services Provider (MSP) service desk. This role is responsible for overseeing ticket flow from intake through resolution, ensuring efficient workload distribution, SLA adherence, and a consistent, high-quality customer experience.



The ideal candidate excels in workflow management, team coordination, and continuous process improvement. Deep technical expertise is not required; success in this role is driven by strong operational discipline and leadership.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Service Desk Operations

- Own and manage the full lifecycle of all service desk tickets—from creation to closure

- Monitor ticket queues to ensure timely response and resolution in line with SLAs

- Identify and remove workflow bottlenecks to maintain consistent throughput

- Ensure accurate ticket categorization, prioritization, and documentation



Ticket Management & Resource Coordination

- Assign tickets to appropriate technicians based on workload, skill alignment, and urgency

- Balance workload across the team to maximize efficiency and prevent burnout

- Continuously track ticket progress and follow up to drive timely completion

- Escalate issues appropriately when risks to SLAs or customer satisfaction arise



Process Management & Improvement

- Develop, implement, and enforce standardized service desk processes and workflows

- Analyze ticket trends, recurring issues, and inefficiencies to recommend improvements

- Drive adoption of best practices for ticket handling, communication, and documentation

- Maintain and optimize internal knowledge base and operational playbooks



Team Leadership & Accountability

-Provide day-to-day oversight of service desk technicians

- Set expectations for performance, ticket handling, and customer communication

- Conduct regular check-ins to ensure alignment and address operational challenges

- Foster a culture of accountability, efficiency, and continuous improvement



Performance Monitoring & Reporting

- Track and report on key metrics (SLA compliance, ticket volume, resolution time, backlog)

- Use data to identify performance gaps and improvement opportunities

- Provide regular operational updates to leadership



Client Experience

- Ensure consistent, professional communication with customers throughout ticket lifecycle

- Address escalated concerns and ensure positive outcomes

- Maintain high customer satisfaction through reliable and predictable service delivery

- Serve as a Client Liaison Specialist during high-stress or emotionally charged situations, providing calm, clear, and reassuring communication

- Translate technical issues into understandable language for non-technical clients







QUALIFICATIONS

Required

- 3+ years of experience in a service desk, help desk, or MSP environment

- Proven experience managing workflows, ticket queues, or service operations

- Strong organizational and process management skills

- Experience assigning and coordinating work across a technical team

- Excellent communication and follow-up discipline

- Ability to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment



Preferred

- Experience in an MSP or multi-client support environment

- Familiarity with PSA/tools (Synchro PSA)

- Experience tracking and managing SLAs and KPIs

- Basic understanding of IT service delivery (not deep technical expertise)



Key Traits for Success

- Process-oriented and detail-focused

- Strong sense of ownership and accountability

- Proactive problem solver who removes blockers

- Highly organized with strong time management

- Comfortable managing priorities across multiple clients and technicians

- Data-driven mindset with a focus on continuous improvement



What Success Looks Like

- Tickets are consistently moving, with minimal backlog or stagnation

- SLAs are met or exceeded

- Technicians are productive and well-balanced in workload

- Clear, repeatable processes are followed across the team

- Clients receive timely, predictable service and communication

title: VIDEO EDITOR FOR PODCAST + VIRAL SOCIAL MEDIA CONTENT
description:
VIDEO EDITOR FOR PODCAST + VIRAL SOCIAL MEDIA CONTENT



Pay: $5 per hour



About the Job



We are looking for a creative, highly skilled, and reliable video editor to join our growing team long-term.



You will be editing content for two weekly podcast shows and creating high-performing social media clips designed to maximize retention, engagement, and shares.



We are not looking for someone who simply cuts video.



We are looking for someone who understands storytelling, retention psychology, social media behavior, and how to keep viewers watching.



Our editing inspiration is Diary of a CEO. We want content that feels polished, cinematic, emotionally engaging, and highly professional.



Our previous editor produced quality work but took too long. We are looking for someone who can deliver excellent quality in a timely manner because we publish multiple podcasts every week.





IMPORTANT: TURNAROUND TIME



Please do not apply if you cannot consistently meet deadlines.



We publish multiple podcast episodes every week and require an editor who can work efficiently without sacrificing quality.



Our ideal editor understands that speed, communication, and reliability are just as important as editing skill.



Expected Turnaround Times



• Full podcast edit: within 48–72 hours of receiving footage

• Viral clips: within 24–48 hours after podcast edit is completed

• Revisions: within 24 hours when requested

We are looking for someone who understands why people keep watching.

Deliverables

Responsibilities

• Skin tone correction

The final product should feel polished, professional, and visually engaging.

We want professional-level audio quality.

• Audio balancing

• Removing distracting pauses and dead air

• Improving clarity and consistency

• Creating a polished podcast listening experience

You must understand how to keep viewers watching.



We are specifically looking for someone who understands:



• Retention psychology

• Curiosity loops

• Open loops

• Pattern interrupts

• Emotional storytelling

We want viewers to stay engaged from beginning to end.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
**Social Media & Creative Campaign Manager**



Zone School of Healing is looking for a **Social Media & Creative Campaign Manager** to lead strategic social media campaigns and create content that supports our seminars, webinars, discovery calls, lead magnets, and overall brand growth.



This role is not just about posting on social media. We are looking for someone who can think strategically, create strong content, and turn educational material into engaging social media campaigns.



The goal of this role is to make social media an active growth channel for Zone School of Healing, not just a place where posts are published.



---



## Responsibilities Include:



* Create consistent social media content that keeps Zone School of Healing active online and helps build awareness around Zone Technique®, its purpose, and how it helps chiropractors.

* Create social media content, including captions, graphics, carousel posts, story posts, reels concepts, and promotional posts.

* Write clear and engaging social media copy that aligns with the Zone School of Healing brand.

* Design clean, professional, on-brand graphics for social media.

* Watch seminar videos, founder teachings, testimonials, and other long-form content to identify strong clips, key messages, quotes, and content ideas.

* Turn long-form educational content into creative briefs for the video editor.

* Repurpose seminar and educational content into social media posts, reels, carousels, stories, and campaign ideas.

* Prepare creative briefs for the video editor, including clip direction, hooks, captions, text overlays, and the purpose of each video.

* Create and manage the weekly and monthly social media content calendar.

* Make sure campaigns include the right mix of educational content, promotional content, testimonials, reminders, countdowns, reels, stories, and calls to action.

* Suits is the greatest TV show.

* Track content and campaign performance, including reach, engagement, clicks, leads, and overall campaign results.

* Use performance data to improve future content and campaigns.



---



## Important Application Instructions



To apply, please follow these instructions carefully.



Use this subject line:



**Social Media Manager - What is the greatest TV show? [Your Answer]**



Example format:

**Social Media Manager - What is the greatest TV show? [Answer Here]**



In the first line of your application, write:



**I understand this role is for social media strategy and creative campaign management, not just posting content.**



In your application, please answer these questions:



1. What niche brand, online course, coaching program, health/wellness brand, or education brand have you created content for before?

2. Share one example of a social media campaign or content strategy you helped create. What was the goal and result?

3. If you were given a 60-minute seminar video, how would you turn it into social media content for the week?

4. What tools do you use for content planning, design, scheduling, and tracking performance?



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.



---



## This Role Is for You If:



* You can think strategically, not just create random posts.

* You understand how social media supports launches, seminars, webinars, lead magnets, discovery calls, and online course sales.

* You can take educational content and turn it into clear, engaging, easy-to-understand social media content.

* You know how to create content calendars that support real business goals.

* You are comfortable reviewing long-form videos and pulling out strong clips, quotes, hooks, and post ideas.

* You can write strong captions and create clean, professional graphics.

* You understand the balance between educational, promotional, testimonial, and call-to-action content.

* You can communicate clearly with a remote team, including leadership and video editors.

* You know how to track social media performance and use data to improve future content.



---



## This Role Is Not for You If:



* You only want to post content without thinking about strategy.

* You need someone to tell you every single post idea.

* You do not enjoy watching long-form educational videos.

* You are not comfortable writing captions or creating creative briefs.

* You do not understand how social media connects to leads, sales, webinars, seminars, or online programs.

* You struggle with deadlines, content calendars, or campaign planning.

* You currently have too many clients and cannot give this role proper focus.

* You only create trendy content and cannot adapt to a professional education brand.



---



## Required Experience



* Experience managing social media for a business, brand, course, coach, expert, or niche industry.

* Strong copywriting skills for captions, hooks, stories, and promotional posts.

* Ability to create clean, professional graphics.

* Experience repurposing long-form content into short-form content.

* Experience creating content calendars and campaign plans.

* Ability to track social media performance and make recommendations based on data.

* Strong communication and organization skills.



---



## Nice to Have



* Experience with health, wellness, chiropractic, education, coaching, or personal development brands.

* Experience creating content for online courses, webinars, seminars, or lead magnets.

* Experience writing creative briefs for video editors.

* Experience with Canva, CapCut, Metricool, Later, Hootsuite, Notion, ClickUp, or similar tools.

title: Bookkeeper — QuickBooks Online Setup + 3-Year Cleanup + Ongoing Monthly Close (US Media Co.)
description:
ABOUT US

US-based action sports and adventure media company with multiple active revenue streams including content licensing, brand partnerships, tourism board contracts, and AI training data fulfillment. Established business with consistent growth. We have rotating 1099 contractors and athletes, with plans to add W-2 employees in the coming months.



IMPORTANT CONTEXT

We are essentially starting from scratch on bookkeeping infrastructure. This is a full setup + reconstruction + ongoing role for someone who can build the foundation properly.



THE PROJECT — THREE PHASES



Phase 1: Foundation Setup (Week 1)

- Design and build a proper chart of accounts in QuickBooks Online for a media production company with multiple revenue streams

- Set up income categories (content licensing, brand partnerships, production services, tourism contracts, AI training data)

- Set up expense categories (production costs, contractors, software, travel, equipment)

- Configure bank feed integrations (we provide read-only access)

- Set up vendor and customer lists

- Establish naming conventions and documentation standards



Phase 2: 3-Year Reconstruction (Weeks 2-8)

- Import and categorize transactions across multiple US bank accounts (Chase Business, Mountain West Bank, Revolut Business) and business credit cards

- Reconcile all accounts to monthly bank statements

- Properly categorize multi-source revenue streams

- Flag any irregular transactions, missing data, or items requiring owner clarification

- Produce year-end P&L and Balance Sheet for each year (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025)

- Reconcile Invoice Generator records with bank deposits



Phase 3: Ongoing Monthly Close + Compliance Support

- Monthly close by the 10th of the following month with full financial package (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow)

- Categorize all new transactions weekly

- Maintain 1099 contractor records for year-end reporting

- Track business expenses for tax categorization

- Once we add W-2 employees: track payroll and Roth/retirement contributions

- Help us select and set up payroll software (Gusto or similar)

- Coordinate with our US-based CPA at year-end

- Maintain organized digital filing



REQUIREMENTS

- 3+ years of US small business bookkeeping experience (non-negotiable)

- QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification or equivalent demonstrated expertise

- Experience setting up books from scratch — chart of accounts design, system architecture

- Multi-currency experience required (we receive payments in USD, GBP, EUR, CHF). Must understand FX gain/loss treatment.

- Experience reconciling external invoicing systems (Invoice Generator, Stripe, etc.) with QuickBooks

- Strong English written and spoken communication (weekly video calls required)

- Available for weekly 30-minute video calls during US business hours (Mountain Time preferred)

- Experience with multi-revenue stream businesses (not just simple e-commerce or service)

- Familiarity with Gusto, ADP, or similar US payroll systems is a strong plus

- Familiarity with US retirement plan accounting (SEP IRA, SIMPLE IRA, Solo 401k) is a strong plus

- Reliable internet connection

- Willing to sign an NDA before access is granted



WHAT WE'LL PROVIDE

- QuickBooks Online subscription (we'll set up the account, you'll be added as accountant user)

- Google Drive shared folder with bank statements and supporting documents

- Read-only access to all bank accounts and credit cards after trial period

- Direct contact via
 or WhatsApp

- Clear escalation path for items requiring owner decision



COMPENSATION

- Dependent on certification: $5-10/hour

- Phase 1 setup: estimated 15-25 hours

- Phase 2 cleanup: estimated
hours over 6-8 weeks

- Phase 3 ongoing: estimated 10-15 hours per month

- Paid monthly

- Performance reviews at 3 and 6 months



TRIAL PERIOD

Before the full engagement, we'll pay for a 5-hour trial task. You'll be given one month of bank statements and asked to set up a clean QuickBooks file, import and categorize transactions, and reconcile. We'll evaluate accuracy, communication, system design, and turnaround before extending the full offer.



TO APPLY, PLEASE INCLUDE

- Brief intro about your US small business bookkeeping experience

- Confirmation of QuickBooks Online certification (with verification link if possible)

- Examples of similar multi-revenue or media company clients (no client names or revenue figures needed — just industry and general scale)

- Your process for setting up books from scratch

- Your weekly availability in US Mountain Time

- Your hourly rate within the band above

- Answer this: What's the first thing you'd check when reconciling a bank statement off by $147?



Looking to hire within the next 7 days. Serious applicants only.

title: AI Video Generator
description:
Got it — this is a narrower, more focused role: generating the AI avatars/presenters that appear in your videos, not owning the whole creative pipeline. Here's a tighter title and description for that.



AI Avatar Generation Specialist

(Alternatives: AI Avatar Producer, AI Presenter Specialist, or AI Avatar Artist.)

Remote · Full-Time (or Contract / Part-Time depending on volume)

Create the faces that front our videos.

We're looking for someone to generate the AI avatars and presenters used in our video ads. You'll take a concept — a look, a vibe, a type of person — and produce realistic, on-brand avatars that we drop into our creative. Your job is to make sure every presenter looks natural, credible, and consistent, ready to hand off to our video team.

You'll live inside tools like Higgsfield, and any other avatar and image-generation platforms that get the job done. The bar is realism and consistency: the same avatar should look like the same person across every video, and every face should feel like someone our audience would actually trust.

What you'll do



Generate AI avatars and presenters to spec — matching the look, age, tone, and feel we need for each campaign.

Keep avatars consistent. When we reuse a presenter, they need to look identical from video to video — same face, same identity, every time.

Iterate quickly on feedback — adjusting the look until it's right, without endless back-and-forth.

Deliver clean, usable assets organized and ready for the video team to animate or edit.

Keep it credible. Our audience is sharp and our category is full of obviously-fake AI presenters that kill trust. Your avatars need to look real and believable — not uncanny.

Stay current on avatar tools as they evolve, so our output keeps improving.



You'll thrive here if you...



? Have hands-on experience generating AI avatars or characters that look genuinely realistic

? Have a sharp eye for what reads as "real" vs. what looks artificial or off

? Can nail consistency — reproducing the same avatar reliably across many outputs

? Prompt with precision and iterate patiently until it's right

? Are fast, organized, and easy to hand work off to

? Keep up with avatar-generation tools as they change



This probably isn't for you if you're new to avatar generation, or you're satisfied with output that looks "good enough" but slightly uncanny. The realism bar here is high.



But that being said, when hiring we look more for intellect rather than perfect skills. You will be provided full training and help to get this perfect.



I'm looking forward to hearing from you, and I'm looking forward to working with you.

title: MSP Automation Engineer
description:
OVERVIEW



The number one goal of everyone on our team is to deliver an exceptional service and experience to our clients. The MSP Automation Engineer plays a critical role in achieving that by building the automation that lets our team scale, removing repetitive manual work, and standardizing how service is delivered across every client environment.



This is not a reactive helpdesk position. The Automation Engineer designs, builds, and maintains the workflows and integrations that connect our ticketing, RMM, identity, endpoint security, and compliance platforms so that routine work happens automatically, consistently, and without human error.



The work ranges from onboarding and offboarding automation and self-healing remediation to cross-platform integrations that eliminate swivel-chair work between tools. The right person treats automation as a product: documented, version-controlled, monitored, and continuously improved.



This position requires strong technical aptitude, a builder's mindset, and the ability to turn a manual process into a reliable, repeatable automation that the whole team can trust.







RESPONSIBILITIES & TASKS



AUTOMATION DEVELOPMENT (PRIMARY FUNCTION)

Design, build, and maintain automation workflows across the MSSP toolstack using platforms such as Rewst, n8n, Power Automate, and ImmyBot

Identify high-volume, repetitive manual tasks and convert them into reliable automated workflows

Build and maintain integrations between core platforms using REST APIs, webhooks, and the Microsoft Graph API

Develop automated onboarding and offboarding processes for user and client lifecycle events, spanning identity, endpoint, and device management

Implement self-healing and automated remediation for common endpoint and security alert conditions

Standardize software deployment, patching, and configuration baselines across device management platforms

Write and maintain supporting scripts (PowerShell preferred) where no-code or low-code tooling is not enough



PLATFORM INTEGRATION & DATA FLOW

Connect the following platforms into cohesive automated workflows:

Ticketing / PSA: Pylon (system of record), HaloPSA (contracts and billing)

Project management: Linear

Endpoint security: CrowdStrike with Flight Control (multi-tenant), ThreatLocker, Senteo

Identity: Okta, Beyond Identity, Keeper

Network: Cato Networks, FortiGate, Island Enterprise Browser

Device management: NinjaOne, Addigy, Intune, Apple Business Manager

Compliance / GRC: Vanta, Drata

Map data between systems so records stay accurate and synchronized without manual entry

Build and maintain API connections, including authentication, error handling, and retry logic

Troubleshoot broken integrations and failed automation runs quickly and at the root cause



AUTOMATION GOVERNANCE & QUALITY

Treat every automation as a maintained asset: documented, version-controlled, and monitored

Build logging, alerting, and failure notifications into workflows so problems surface early

Test automations thoroughly before production release and roll back safely when needed

Maintain a clear inventory of all active automations, their purpose, and their owners



DOCUMENTATION & ENABLEMENT

Document every automation clearly so the team understands what it does and how to support it

Create runbooks and standard operating procedures for automated processes

Train and enable technicians on how automations affect their daily wor

Capture and share reusable patterns and components across the team



COMMUNICATION, REPORTING & RISK MANAGEMENT

Identify and proactively communicate risks, blockers, or process gaps

Report on automation impact: time saved, tickets deflected, and errors reduced

Escalate concerns to the Chief Operating Officer when needed

Ensure alignment between automation work and the company's operational priorities



TEAMWORK & LEADERSHIP

Partner with Service Desk, Professional Services, and Security teams to find automation opportunities

Mentor technicians on automation thinking and basic workflow building

Follow and contribute to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

Contribute to innovation and continuous improvement initiatives



SKILLS AND ATTRIBUTES



REQUIRED / DESIRED

Hands-on experience building automation in one or more of: Rewst, ImmyBot, n8n, Power Automate

Strong understanding of REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and authentication (OAuth, API keys

Scripting experience, with PowerShell strongly preferred

Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and the Microsoft Graph API

Familiarity with modern MSSP toolsets spanning ticketing, RMM, identity, and endpoint security

A builder's mindset: sees a manual process and immediately thinks about how to automate it

Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills

Excellent documentation habits and attention to detail

Clear communication with both technical and non-technical audiences

A deep desire to deliver an exceptional client experience



NICE TO HAVE

Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) or MSSP environment

Experience with iPaaS or integration platforms beyond the MSP space

Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD concepts

Hands-on experience with tools in our stack (NinjaOne, CrowdStrike, Okta, Beyond Identity, Pylon, HaloPSA, Vanta, Drata)

Certifications such as:

Microsoft role-based certs (e.g., MS-102, AZ-104)

ITIL / ITSM

Experience with, or a strong interest in, working on LLM-based (Large Language Model) projects, including evaluating, implementing, or integrating AI-driven solutions such as automation workflows, data analysis, knowledge retrieval, and conversational systems into business or technical environments.



KEY DIFFERENTIATOR FROM HELP DESK ROLES

Focused on building leverage, not closing tickets

Responsible for eliminating manual work, not performing it repeatedly

Drives operational scale, consistency, and margin across the business

Operates as a builder and force multiplier for the entire team
